description: Neon Breaker is a fun twin-stick horizontal 3d retro shoot 'em up in the legacy of the great action arcade shmup classics. Shoot, evade, and hunt down cute enemy ships to make them all explode! Push your limits playing through endless waves and unlock new high scores.

title: Stick Mania Demo
description: Stick Mania is a mix of 2D/3D platforming elements with stick figures that battle each other until one winner is decided

title: Inearth Demo
description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

title: Chop chop! JUICE SHOP Demo
description: Chop fruit, earn money, unlock powerful upgrades, and create the Ultimate Juice in this colorful incremental action game.

title: Destroy the Flag Demo
description: Try Destroy the Flag against bots! Nobody has HP: bombs launch you, freeze you solid, and hurl you across the map instead. Blast your way to the enemy flag before they blast you first, and survive absurd random events like meteor strikes, bouncing dodgeballs, and rogue ice cubes.

title: Die and Decay Demo
description: Die and Decay DEMO

title: Chaos The Devil Demo
description: A Ps1 era inspired 3D platformer. Run, jump and fly your way through a new adventure, done the old way.

title: UFO98 Demo
description: Defy the government, leak top-secret alien telemetry, and wake up the world… inside an isolated Win98 workstation.

title: Starting a Village from Zero Demo
description: — This is your own village-building story — You are a familiar summoned by Lily, an apprentice witch. Cook meals, construct buildings, and help create a thriving village on Lily's behalf. A new kind of miniscape × roguelite × turn-based strategy game.

title: Geometry TD Demo
description: The free demo of Geometry TD: tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Fly through open space, put your crew to work, and stop a pirate boarding with geometric towers. Play time is limited to 15 minutes.

title: CRADLE PLANT: First Year Operations Demo
Loadpath Demo
description: Try LOADPATH, a first-person physics demolition game. Cut the supports, trigger cascading collapses and turn Salvage into a stronger demolition rig. Explore the first 55 metres of The Midden in this demo.

title: Free Company Demo
description: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

title: Tulip Simulator Demo
description: A Tulip simulator where you crossbreed tulips, uncover impossible genetics, and discover flowers that have never existed before, from delicate heirlooms to crystalline wonders and blooms kissed with gold. Capture your rarest creations and share them with the world.

title: Reroll or Die Demo
description: Reroll or Die is a roguelike deck-builder where everything is decided by dice rolls. Yes, even the start button. But fortunately you can turn the odds in your favor: reroll, upgrade, invert, split, combine, increase or decrease your rolls, then slot them into your weapon and armor cards.

title: Connected Hearts: Vanished Beauty Collector's Edition Demo
description: A seaside cult is choosing its victims. Uncover dark secrets, solve puzzles, and stop a prophet before his final ritual begins.

title: Kill King 2D Demo
description: Kill King 2D is a dark fantasy 1v1 tactical auto-battler. Secretly queue orders and spend Action Points, then watch your pieces carry out the plan on their own. Evolve your army, outpredict your rival, and kill the enemy King.
developer: Anton Katkov, Nikita Gavrilchik, Dmitriy Shchepetkov

title: Aesthoria : Beyond The Realm Demo
description: A monster-collector tactical JRPG inspired from Digimon World 2, where you summon, train, evolve, and command mysterious Aesther through grid-based battles and dangerous expeditions into the shifting realm of Vanadis.

title: Country Walk Demo
description: A relaxing walking and exploration game set in the ever-changing countryside of Avelon. Follow winding paths, meet and talk with travellers, take photographs, build your photo album and share unique walks with others using Waymarks.

title: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator Demo
description: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

title: Demon Crisis Demo
description: A classic On-Rails Shooter, compatible with every modern USB lightgun with live recoil. Hide in cover to avoid hits and reload, then emerge to shoot your way through a horde of bloodthirsty demons.

title: HABAP Demo
description: A cozy reseller sim set behind the iron curtain: comb the flea markets, haggle stubborn sellers down, and flip your finds through a little shop of your own. One catch: profiteering is a capital offense here, so every ruble of profit goes toward escaping the country - before they come for you.

title: JUST PRESS SPACE Demo
description: JUST PRESS SPACE is a brutal pixel-art roguelite where one button controls everything.

title: SteelBlade Shop Simulator Demo
description: SteelBlade Shop Simulator lets you run your own SteelBlade shop in the streets of Japan. Open SteelBlade boxes, collect parts with different tiers, build powerful SteelBlades, sell them for profit, or take them into the arena and compete to prove your skill.

title: Izzy's Arcade Demo
description: This is a PREVIEW DEMO of Izzy's Arcade, which is still in development. In this spin-off of Intrepid Izzy, the plucky heroine returns to explore a video game arcade filled with strange, funny, quirky and experimental little games.

title: Foundation: Galactic Frontier Demo
description: Command Asimov's OFFICIAL Foundation universe! Live the life as an interstellar trader to exploit your trade routes! Build your starship home, crush enemies in explosive shootouts & outsmart rivals with fleet strategies in epic space wars - with new content expanding your saga!

title: No, Chef! Demo
description: Your restaurant has a design flaw: a wall. Chefs can't hear waiters, except through one tiny window. Take the orders, cook them exactly, make rent. Two shifts in this demo. Co-op only: bring at least one friend.

title: 红楼梦华录 Red Chamber Chronicle Demo
description: Red Chamber Chronicle is a classical Chinese life simulation and visual novel with multiple endings. You play as Jia Baoyu in the Grand View Garden, where daily life, relationships, and choices shape your branching story and different outcomes.

title: Tempus Inceptum Demo
description: Build, trade and scheme your way to victory in a dynamic economic strategy game. Claim territory, create production chains, trade on the stock exchange and outmanoeuvre rival factions.

title: Herding Adventures Demo
description: Demo of Herding Adventures, a 3rd person realistic cozy MMORPG where players can herd sheep and hang out with their friends.
developer: Heaven's Blessings Tiny Zoo, Heaven's Blessings Tiny Zoo, LLC

title: Humans & Vampires Demo
description: Survive the night together. Claim your own haven, build towers, chop wood and upgrade your door while Varkolak, an ancient vampire lord, hunts you until dawn. Online co-op for 1–8 players, with roguelite upgrades and bots for any empty seat.

title: Attunement Demo
description: In a world where music can wound, the most virtuosic musicians are the strongest fighters. Live their stories in this deckbuilder turn-based RPG. Build your deck of music scores and compose a song as you play!

title: リサイクルショップ回向 Demo
description: 3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game. Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

title: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress Demo
description: A co-op dungeon runner. Fight through the shifting towers, loot powerful gear and develop new skills. Challenge bosses and free the villagers town in this Action-RPG. The tower will change, but each fountain will save your progress until you face the evil wizard himself.

title: Bloomstead Demo
description: Play the free demo of Bloomstead, a cozy 2D pixel-art farming RPG. Build your farm, raise animals, fish, and explore a living village with day/night cycle.

title: STEEL VANGUARD:Project ARES Trial Version
description: This is the demo version of “STEEL VANGUARD: Project ARES.”.Please note that save data from the demo cannot be carried over to the full game. Set in a sci-fi world, this top-down shooter challenges you to complete missions and earn the title of “ARES,” the strongest pilot.

title: Tank of the Fittest Demo
developer: Wuhan Wind Tunnel Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: Splorbit Demo
description: Splorbit is a physics-driven horde survival game. This demo is the first world of the full game (which has 5 worlds). Bounce, split and explode balls through swarming enemies, build a loadout from upgrade cards, and survive 20 minutes of dense enemy waves. Solo or local co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Survival Billiards Demo
description: One cue ball. A table full of red balls. Enemies closing in. Survival Billiards combines billiards physics with turn-based tactics: push enemies back with the cue ball, deal damage with red balls, and bounce shots off the rails to chain hits. Plan your moves and find a way out of the encirclement.

title: Celestial Sentinel Demo
description: This is Xhono overwatch space station. Enemy forces are attacking. All kinds of turrets, space station supports and plugins at your disposal. Please use your resources wisely, build your defense, face against all kinds of enemies, and explore the unknown secrets of Xhono.
developer: 野象游戏工作室 Elephas Game Studio

title: Anomaly Core: Hospital Demo
description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

title: RULEBALL Demo
description: Choose the rules, then watch football discs put your plan to the test. This free demo includes one complete 5-match roguelite season, 12 rule cards, the Daily Cup and the Rule Lab. Every rule affects both teams.

title: Wager of Banners Demo
description: Your village is one of several on a small island, and none of the others intend to stay small. Build it out of what it already makes, sharpen a deck that reshuffles every night, and pick your fights carefully. Beaten villagers here are not killed. They are taken, and they do not come back.

title: First Round Hit - The Long Range Shooting Simulator Demo
Knight's Party Demo
description: The kingdom ran out knights, but someone still had to participate royal tournaments. Challenge your friends in a series of quick fire events, each with its own venue, three line rules, and method of making you force to survive.You are here to be pretending like a knight to win the tournaments!

title: Scry Demo
description: Scry is a turn-based tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you play as a heretic, banished to a prison plane for blasphemy. Battle through caves, catacombs, and a cosmic palace, build powerful decks, and slay antediluvian horrors.

title: A (tiny) Slime Quest Demo
description: In this short demo, you play as a harmless Slime at the beginning of its adventure in a cozy top down world. Explore the Exile Village and learn your first skills by interacting with quirky villagers. What will your role be in this combat free world based on mutual aid?

title: A Game About Clicking A Rock Demo
description: This is early demo build (alpha version)

title: Knockout Kiss💋 Demo
description: Free demo of Knockout Kiss. Five women have gone missing in a neon-lit city. In this demo only Diana is playable: track her down in the Old Harbor across 3 missions with one-button combat (tap to strike, hold to charge, release). 18+ only.

title: Foxtrot Creamery Demo
description: Start your very own ice cream empire in this 2D business/dating simulator! Meet new people, find true love, and build alongside your local community!

title: Guns & Gambits Demo
description: Guns & Gambits Demo is a high-octane chess horde-survival roguelite. Command sentient chess companions, wield devastating firearms, unlock game-breaking gambits, and blast through relentless waves of rogue chess pieces to checkmate the dark monarch in bullet-heaven action.

title: Mythical Whalers Demo
description: Set sail in the shrouded seas. A procedurally generated world where each voyage is unique. Captain a crew of mythical races to face monstrous leviathans and gain status with cunning factions.

title: Project: C.E.L.L. Demo
description: An arcade incremental where you run cellular simulations for a megacorp obsessed with immortality. Break glucose, build combos, and spend ATP across a massive skill tree. Experiment with different glucose types, proteins, and lipids from your retro terminal.

title: Slottoki Demo
description: The slot machine roguelike. Level up your symbols, collect powerful items, and create game-breaking builds to win big.

title: PactSworn Demo
description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

title: Fruit Kombat Demo
description: Free demo of the viral brain-rot fruit novela turned chaotic 3D fighting game. Four fruit brawlers, a guided tutorial that teaches every move, offline duel and four-fruit deathmatch, plus online rooms for your friends. Farm aura and unleash weapon ultimates.

title: Syncblade Demo
description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

title: Schema Demo
description: Try Schema free. Step into Carbon, a barren planet that people are working to bring to life with little more than their hands, and play in worlds your friends build in Schema. All it takes is the code they give you.

title: Stepwell Demo
description: Stepwell is a microscopic dimension where you build optical illusions that defy the laws of physics. Snap together impossible geometry to create twisting, mind-bending paths for your Quarks. Relax in a vibrant, zen-like puzzle, and watch your creations come alive as a hypnotic, bustling colony.
developer: Jeff Krause, Alex Krause, Tim Fowers, Adrian Graumann

title: Halloween Tidy Up Demo
description: Race through a whimsical haunted manor, gather matching clutter into your satchel, return every treasure to its proper place, and banish mischievous spirits before the clock strikes midnight.

title: Phantom Fleet Demo
description: Command Hollow King in a naval action roguelite. Sink ships, harvest souls, and recruit a ghost fleet. Shape your build with upgrade cards and five automatic skill slots. Break blockades across ten seas, then rise stronger after sinking with permanent shipyard upgrades.

title: Terraform Co: Factory and City Demo
Raging Blasters 2 Demo
description: This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup.Players choose from three pilots to control, board a fighter jet, and defeat enemies. The game follows classic shmup mechanics: fire shots to defeat enemies and avoid bullets, making it a simple yet addictive game.

title: Warring Kingdoms: Chronicles of War Demo
description: A RPG where you build and rule a fantasy kingdom, manage resources, command large-scale battles, and use your character's abilities to change the course of war.

title: Counterweight Demo
description: A social deduction tower-builder for 3–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Saboteur Detector before every block hits the ground.

title: Whispers from Below Demo
description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

title: Oddlay Demo
description: Flip the grid with overlapping pieces where placement matters. Take your time with this relaxing puzzle game as the challenge grows. Can you beat the Oddlay?

title: Gladitta Demo
description: Become the ultimate Dungeon Tester! In Gladitta, your job is to assure villains that their evil lair is hero-proof! In this very challenging precision platformer, you need to finish the leves as soon as possible to earn your payday!

title: Colossus Demo
description: In this co-op game, join a friend in a space mission and configure computers to complete a misterious mission.

title: Grazed - Incremental Arcade Demo
description: The closer you get, the stronger you get. Grazed is an incremental arcade game where every kill means getting within range of death. Push your kill combo high enough to ignite absurd powers and chase the highest score. Every run earns upgrades, so you always come back deadlier.

title: DREADMOOR Demo
description: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

title: At Fate's End Demo
description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

title: Watch Party: Watch the Web Together (Demo)
description: Watch Party is a virtual movie theater where you and your friends watch the web together — synced, in the same room, with voice chat, board games, and popcorn you can actually throw. No friends online? Browse public rooms and meet someone new over a movie.

title: Tower And Dragon Demo
description: Retro back to the year 1977! With the Commodore PET, computers finally became accessible to the masses.It only had 8K.Explore the PET with unprecedented depth as you play the 2D RPG. You play the warrior Frederick, driven by steel, dreams, & conviction. The Demo is limited to zone 0 and the village.

title: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager Demo
KAARTEL Demo
description: A hidden-movement strategy game: analyze the map, track the thief across Europe, catch them before they escape.

title: Trap Testers Demo
description: Traps Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

title: Corner Pocket: World Billiards Demo
description: Play American 8-Ball, 9-Ball, Chinese 8-Ball, Brazilian Mata-8, Free Pyramid and Blackball. Play in the English Club. Preview City Tournament, Jiangnan Courtyard, Neon Lounge, Coastal Sunset, Alpine Lodge and Vintage Jazz Salon. One table tier is available. Separate Demo chips refill when insufficient for entry.

title: Touhou Renju Demo
description: An online battle game where you place girls from Gensokyo like in a game of Go! However, since the goal is to compete based on how well they get along, you can only win when the girls next to each other are friends. Enjoy the strategies created by their abilities and relationships!

title: Never Sort By Color Demo
description: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

title: Garden Souls Demo
description: Garden Souls is a 2D action roguelite focused on fast combat, stylish combos and build crafting. Choose one of the four Garden Princesses, unlock new strikes, combine elements and adapt your combat style each run to face corrupted floral biomes and stop the Mandragora.

title: Passage 5 Demo
description: Easy to learn, hard to put down: place tiles, match color or symbol, clear passages from the board. The casual classic is back — completely revamped, with four modes, over 300 levels, and for the first time two players on one screen: together or in a duel.

title: Too Many Cats in the Plant Shop! Demo
止战之战：The Great War Demo
Love, Death & My Daughter Demo
description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free short-form pixel-art narrative game. Walk through a rain-soaked cemetery, repair system faults, and sift through memories and files. Amid subtle horror and distortion, come to understand the love a mother left behind.

title: HyperPipes Demo
description: YOU RACE ON THE OUTSIDE OF A PIPE.You’re racing a hovering ship on the outside of a giant pipe. Gravity is always trying to pull you down. Staying on top is the fastest line.Sliding down the side is not a crash. There is no wall unless your too ahead, no reset, no penalty. You can climb back up from anywhere, including underneath.

title: NOVA Demo
description: The first chapter of Nova, free and complete. Twelve hand built levels of fast, minimalist real-time strategy, played with one mouse. Every world you hold grows forces, so fling them at the next one. Learn the loop the whole game is built on, then see what eleven more chapters do with it.

title: Couch Pirates Demo
description: Couch Pirates! is an easy to play local Wi-Fi party game that allows anyone to play using their phone or gamepad! Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island. The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening.

title: Rainfusor Demo
description: Each element combination creates its own playstyle. Reclaim the lost parts of yourself in rooms in a side-scroller physics rogue-arcade without any boring stat boosts or platforming. Rip apart segmented bugs, uncover new runes and synergies and find crazy emergent mechanics

title: Dealer's Hand Demo
description: A gothic blackjack rogue-lite. Manipulate your odds with powerups, special cards and effects to win the souls of the damned and choose to either slay or set them free.

title: Send In The Clown Demo
description: A bite-sized birthday catastrophe clown comedy role-playing experience – with minigames!

title: Skewered Up! Demo
description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

title: ROTETRA Demo
description: ROTETRA is a slightly cursed spin on a classic falling block puzzle game. Twist your brain as you stack pieces falling from all directions.

title: Towers of Babble Demo
description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

title: 尚武誌 Demo
description: Martial Art’s History: Early Republican China kung fu fighter inspired by classic kung fu films. Play varied warriors with unique authentic martial arts. Retro flat art depicts old dojos and arenas, with single-player story and local 2P duels & solid fluid melee combat.

title: Bake Until Done Demo
description: Bake Until Done is a baking-themed, turn-based roguelite. Take control of a muffin as you battle devious desserts to break the spell of a magical bakery that is endangering your town. Fight back with your muffin’s morsels, but be careful not to lose too much…

title: Archmage Divine Demo
description: Archmage Divine is a 2D RPG featuring strategic card-based combat and deckbuilding. Explore vast cities and kingdoms, gather unique items and equipment, and enhance your deck as you progress on your journey. If you’re just looking to battle, our Roguelike mode is available at any time.

title: Main Street Operator Demo
description: You bought a rundown laundromat. Open the doors, clean the floor, fix what you can, set prices and hours, serve real customers, collect the coins, count the cash, and finish your first day as the new owner. The turnaround starts here.

title: Veyora Demo
description: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with survival and farming elements made from a solo developer. Choose your spot, build a farm, home or base, explore the world and play solo or with friends.

title: Ashburrow Demo
description: Descend alone or with up to five friends into a gnoll warren where death ends the run but not the story. Fight with blade, shield and spell, bank your gold into permanent unlocks, and hire militia to hold the gate when the clan musters to take it back.

title: The Debt We Sow Demo
description: Grow crops, automate your farm, unlock powerful systems, and confront an ever-growing debt in a story-driven incremental farming game.

title: Three Kingdoms: March Demo
description: Command armies, develop cities, and shape the Three Kingdoms. Try story arcs 1–3 and a conquest campaign as Cao Cao or Sun Ce, with up to five in-game years (60 turns) per campaign.

title: Bug Fix Billionaire Demo
description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and take the first steps toward growing your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire.

title: Debtrize Demo
description: You are a debt collector tasked with tracking down everyone who owes a debt in the afterlife. Journey through grim lands full of dangerous creatures and old accounts. Hunt them down. Kill. Negotiate. Even death doesn't free you from debt.

title: Dealer Principal: The Dealership Simulator Demo
Island Raiders Demo
description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

title: Somnesis: The PSX Tapes Demo
description: A 2000s psychological horror game about a young girl who uncovers a box of cursed 90s VHS cartridges in her new home. Play eerie PSX-style retro games on a CRT monitor while simultaneously managing threats in your dark bedroom. Balance nostalgic retro gameplay with real-time survival.

title: Too Hot To Hold Demo
description: Grab the Ember and RUN! Hot potato with a TWIST. Try the free demo for up to 10 players, where tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, wield guns, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

title: Head Miner Demo
description: Start with a simple mining setup and turn it into a powerful resource empire. Automate your work, discover valuable materials, upgrade your equipment, and make smart investments to keep your operation growing.

title: TaskPatch Demo
description: A delightful desktop companion that turns your to-do list into a little farm. Tasklings will dig and grow crops, keep you company while you work, turn finished tasks into sunflowers, or send them to a spooky crypt. Track your time, focus with Pomodoro, or take a Solitaire break without distractions.

title: Sort Them Socks Demo
description: A cozy sorting game. A room is buried under thousands of pairs of socks, you, and 64 empty cabinets line the walls. Match every pair by colour, pattern and price, hang it on the right rod, and watch the shelves fill up one satisfying row at a time.

title: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend Demo
developer: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

title: Castellan Demo
description: The free demo of Castellan, a real-time roguelite castle defense made by a solo developer. Play the first 3 chapters: shoot from your castle, drag soldier cards onto the field and cast spells. Open chests, grow your upgrade tree and defeat three bosses.

title: House of the Lost: Revived Demo
description: House of the Lost: Revived is a top-down action roguelike about exploring a haunted house. You'll be clearing rooms, crafting weapons and learning from every death. In this demo you can tackle the first two levels and first boss, either solo, or with a friend in local co-op.

title: VOID PROFIT: Aetrocor Trial Vessel
description: Fly a rented corporate vessel through the Core system in this free demo of VOID PROFIT. Navigate risky routes, trade in changing markets and take on jobs. Smuggle cargo or keep your manifest clean. Stay profitable.

title: Rank Risk: Guess the Order Demo
beautiful freaks of the desert - demo
description: This is the demo for 'beautiful freaks of the desert', a hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic, that requires lightning fast reactions and strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the beginning of the trip...

title: 休谟指数 / Hume Index Demo
I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss Demo
Stack & Sus Demo
description: Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

title: Diss Diss Discussion Demo
description: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

title: The Infinite Shift: Backrooms Demo
description: The Infinite Shift is a psychological horror exploration game. As a pool cleaner caught in an unending shift, traverse eerie liminal spaces from submerged Poolrooms to Level 0. Solve environmental puzzles, evade lurking entities, and try to escape—before you drown in the depths of the Backrooms.

title: Metromino Demo
description: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.

title: Cozy and Tidy Demo
description: Cozy and Tidy is a calm and relaxing organizer game where you can forget about daily stress by sorting, stacking and organizing your belongings.

title: Do You Want To Know Your Oshi? Demo
description: You became a VTuber firm's security guard to protect your dearest Oshi. Verify visitor's legitimacy in this document inspection adventure game. As you weigh the rules against the love for your Oshi, the vibrant VTuber firm begins to show its deep, dark colors within.

title: Brain Boost Fit Demo
description: Just fit the blocks — yet you won't be able to stop. "Brain Boost Fit" is a genuine block-packing puzzle with 1,500 stages. Drag the pieces and fill the board perfectly to clear. No time limits, no fail states.

title: Idle Dungeon: Endless Expedition Demo
description: Idle Dungeon: Endless Expedition is a dark pixel-art idle RPG. Recruit adventurers from five classes, customize their gear and talents, and choose automatic or manual combat as you explore haunted graveyards and dungeons to challenge powerful demon bosses.

title: ClearIt M4 Demo
description: Test your aim and puzzle-solving skills! Shoot colorful balls, match them by color, trigger chain reactions and overcome unique obstacles. Explore challenging levels, use powerful special elements and compete against the computer!

title: StarL 9 Ashes Of The Past Demo
Weekend Solitaire 7 Grace In Motion Demo
waga-mom_demo
description: ――My curfew is 8 PM. Having a helicopter mom is annoying, but it's not a big deal.

title: Totally Nutz: An 80s Adventure - Demo
description: Step back into the 80s in this hand-drawn, hidden-object puzzle adventure about a family of squirrels chasing a big dream. Join the Nutz family as they journey from their quiet home in the suburbs to the big city in search of the legendary Acorn Games.

title: Of Dice and Minions Demo
description: Play the tutorial and the first 20 floors of Of Dice and Minions. Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight its way past two bosses who roll dice of their own. Demo progress uses its own save.

title: Churro Maniacs Demo
description: Churro Maniacs is the narrative simulation video game where you master the art of selling churros while travelling into the space. You will start with the basic foodtruck in your hometown, but as the business grows you can travel to other planets, discover new ingredients, customers and challenges!

title: Tomori: The Lampkeepers Demo
description: When the lamps go out, the world turns to ash. In this demo, an apprentice Lampkeeper follows her vanished master into an ash-choked mine. Command-based exploration, escape-room puzzles, turn-based battles. The prologue and Chapter 1, about 40-60 minutes.

title: Planet Frog Demo
description: Planet Frog is a punishing precision platformer masked as a low-budget nature documentary. Master the movement to escape the terrarium, and rage-bait the narrator as you fall.

title: Vampire Invasion Demo
description: Play the Vampire Invasion demo and command a horde of vampires in this pixel-art reverse tower defense. Strategically deploy unique vampire units, use their abilities, and overcome human defenses and deadly traps as you fight to destroy the objective.

title: Free Kick Demo
description: A 2.5D free-kick demo: pixel art on a 3D pitch. Pick your taker, read the wall, bend it through wind and rain. Aim, power, curve. The keeper shuts the corner. Train to sharpen your shot. Made by a dev who grew up on Winning Eleven and PES.

title: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure - Demo
Gamble Hunters Demo
description: Hunt for 60 seconds, then bet your haul at the casino! Try the free demo of Gamble Hunters, a co-op action roguelite for up to 4 players. Dive into exciting battles, try your luck at casino games, and collect artifacts and boost your stats to prepare for the next hunt.

title: ECHOLAND Demo
description: ECHOLAND is an idle mining game that quietly continues digging away in the corner of your desktop. Unearth the traces of humanity on an Earth where no one remains. The past cannot be changed. — But its memories can still be uncovered.

title: SUPERPANEL Demo
description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

title: Wanderer of Spaces Demo
description: A lighthearted first-person puzzle game based on real architectural designs. Dive into the inner world of an architect, travel through realistic and imaginary spaces, and experience the architect's career from the beginning to self-fulfillment.

title: Northgard Battlegrounds Demo
description: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

title: Only Mining Demo
description: A short demo to start becoming the ultimate town miner. Strip away the farming, the town chores, and all other distractions so you can focus on 'Only Mining'. Every ladder found sends you toward larger rock and more valuable rewards. How deep will you descend before you run out of air?

title: GrimKeep Demo
description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

title: MOLTYN Demo
description: Melt a city into the sea. The free demo for MOLTYN: a volcanic island, seven powers of the earth and five story missions, including a kaiju siege and a fight with your own shadow. Every pixel is live matter that runs, cracks and falls. The island sandbox has no timer and no fail state.

title: Witch's Last Curse Demo
description: A dark medieval fantasy RPG of mystery and magic. As the last Apprentice of a dead Witch, you must break your Master's final curse before it destroys the town, or the town turns on you. Manage stats, coin, and NPC relationships across a handful of daily actions while fighting back the curse.

title: Hokko Spaces Demo
description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

title: Höllenburg 'Hell Castle' Demo
description: "Hollenburg, Hellish Castle" is an action horror arcade game. As Father Karras, explore a satanic castle to stop the dark army. Solve puzzles, use magic to control time, and collect sacred objects to level up. Will you be able to defeat the generals of evil?

title: WARONOMY Demo
description: Waronomy is a turn-based fantasy strategy conquest wargame set in a medieval magic world, where strategy is everything: raise armies, empower heroes, forge elite stacks, and annihilate rival warlords until every castle on the map is yours.

title: MovingLog Demo
description: Three of you carry one log to the flag.Sounds simple. Steer the LogThe log runs on plain, honest physics. One person walks left, the log tilts left. When three people have three different ideas, the log faithfully reflects all three and goes absolutely nowhere. Start shouting. That's the control scheme.

title: How To Ride Elevator Like A Human Demo
description: A chill puzzle game about an alien trying to understand one of humanity’s strangest social rules: why does everyone avoid eye contact in elevators?

title: Neon Gamble Trail Demo
description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

title: Streamer Survival Demo
description: A frantic survival-style game where you control the character while your chat (Twitch, YouTube, and Kick) generates enemies in real time using commands. Survive waves of enemies influenced by dynamic weather as your community does everything in its power to destroy you.

title: MeMoMi Remake Demo
description: The MeMoMi Remake demo features a complete playable section from the beginning of the game.The demo is still in development. Some visuals, text, and features may be changed in the full release.

title: Unmoored Isle Demo
description: On a remote offshore island, players enjoy a simulation game blending farming, business, city-building, and defense. Core gameplay: grow crops, run shops, construct the town, and repel pirate raids. A unique gate-interrogation system lets players screen travelers, balancing order and prosperity.

title: Jet Scalawag: The King of Shooters Demo
description: Fight the mother of all space battles in an epic space combat shooter to end all space combat shooters! In this demo, Jet Scalawag must shoot down the enemy fighters of the alien armada and survive their onslaught. Later features will involve the defence of earth's military forces and space station.

title: Incident 24 Demo
description: A hand-drawn 2D action platformer set in a sci-fi world. Explore the perilous Ancient Ruins No. 24, master fluid movement to dodge deadly traps, and utilize precise combat mechanics to fight mutated monsters for survival.

title: Frostwake: The Last Ember Demo
description: A survival city builder on the ice. Keep the Furnace burning, feed and house the last people on Earth, write the laws that decide what they become, and hold the walls when the Thaw wakes what froze on the slope.

title: 循环公寓：访客 Demo
description: You’ve come to visit a friend you haven’t seen in years. 305 is unlocked, but no one is home. When you try to leave, the apartment building changes. Find a way out.

title: Ablahshikar Demo
description: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

title: Clowntown Demo
description: A co-op minigame campaign for 2-8 clowns. Collaborate or sabotage your way through evolving minigames and hand-crafted action puzzles and that will have you laughing, screaming, and honking with your friends.

title: Welcome to Hell Resort! DEMO
description: Try Welcome to Hell Resort!, a tower defense game built around tile placement. Extend corridors, combine turrets, traps, and guard stations, and choose blueprints to build your defenses in hell.

title: Pretty Home Run Derby - Re: Return of KUSOGAKI Demo
description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

title: Disbond Demo
description: A PvP multiplayer zombie shooter. 2 game modes. 8 classes. One of you's already infected. You just don't know which one yet. Barricade, escape, retaliate.. Do what you must to survive and lead the scoreboard, but who can you truly trust? Because one bite turns you and the wrong turn bites you.

title: Drapers: Merchants of Middle Ages Demo
description: Build a medieval trade empire in under 30 minutes! Produce luxury cloth, manage your economy resources, and outsmart up to 7 rivals in this turn-based, Euro-style tabletop board game. Play solo or over LAN. Will you dominate the Mediterranean market or lose it all to pirates?

title: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light Demo
Fall Off Reach Demo
description: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

title: Fluendora: The realm of scribes Demo
Stealthmate: A chess puzzle Demo
description: Play the Stealthmate demo: solve stealth puzzles with chess movement, team up in local co-op, or challenge a bot or another player in local and online Versus. Read patrols, plan your moves, and lead your pieces to safety.

title: MR MAGEBOY Demo
description: A cozy incremental game about an aspiring mage trying to start a business selling resources. Upgrade your spells, explore biomes, and help your village!

title: Lootkeeper: Tidy up the loot Demo
The Lubs 2: Straw Hats Demo
description: The Lubs 2 : Straw Hats is a 2D action platformer game with RPG factors. Answer the Holy Council's call and fight against Krilton rebellion! The Straw Hats must be paid of their debt and Yunlingen must be in peace again!

title: Artist's Toolkit! Demo
description: Your everyday art asset toolbox. Remove backgrounds, extract frames, split transparent images into layers, and arrange assets in freeform or grid layouts. With video and pixel tools plus PNG, ZIP and PSD export, Artist's Toolkits helps you spend less time preparing assets and more time creating.

title: Jaded Jade Jayden Demo
description: Help Jayden get rid of those pesky workers that entered princess Yunlong palace uninvited!

title: Motive Power Demo
description: Take charge of BR's diesel fleet from 1968 to 1971. Twelve classes, from the 08 shunters to the Deltics, and every locomotive an individual. Four years of the real railway: the Westerns and Deltics in their prime, the Hymeks and Warships running down.

title: Be a Pirate! Demo
description: Defend your pirate fleet from the Crownsmen - and the monsters that lurk beneath. Command Cannons, Voodoo Cauldrons and more across the land and sea, rescue and upgrade a crew of missing pirate captains to assist you while you face down the Crown and their dark plan. Think, don't just click!

title: Fill the Sky Demo
description: A factory automation game where you are the mind of a self-replicating interstellar probe. Turn barren rock and ocean into sprawling industry that feeds the data centers you run on. Launch copies of yourself until they fill the sky. No enemies. Build at your own pace.

title: DeckDEX - TCG Live Simulator DEMO
description: Buy low, read the room, flip it. DeckDEX is a card-flipping market tycoon: hunt underpriced cards on a live player economy, rip packs, forge duplicates into rarities, complete sets, and build a cardboard empire.

title: Horror Stories: Social Problems Demo
description: An unsettling blend of life simulation and psychological horror with PSX style visuals. Rebuild your life, find a job, explore the town, and uncover what hides beneath an ordinary routIne.

title: Pouring Pints Demo: First Rounds On Us
Mind the Clown: Reborn Demo
description: A first-person survival horror game set in a cursed circus shaped by childhood memories. Move carefully and hide from the demonic clown stalking you. Explore dangerous attractions and burn circus posters to break the curse and save your life.

title: Jellystar Empires: When Space Bunnies Attack!! Demo
Dead Set Warriors Demo
description: Unleash the fighters of time once more for a showdown unlike no-other! Fight your way through different time periods, use your environment to your advantage and become the ultimate warrior!

title: 101 Circuits Demo
description: Build circuits and match target waveforms in the 101 Circuits demo. Connect components, inspect signals on the oscilloscope, and learn how each part works. Use Sandbox to experiment with your own circuits. No programming required.

title: Back on Your Feet Demo
description: A boxing action-adventure built on redemption. Fight up a tournament bracket where every opponent has a story of his own, make choices you can't take back, and circle, weave, and throw every punch yourself. Do you have what it takes to get back on your feet?

title: SUPER GAHAKU Demo
description: Draw in 3D space! Create hilariously wonky sculptures from topics, then laugh and guess what everyone was trying to make. The worse you are at drawing, the more fun it gets! In the demo version, “Create and Guess” is playable (multiplayer only).

title: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle Demo
description: Build routes, solve the first 10 Puzzle levels, and read your rival in hidden-block battles. Play 5 Classic games and 3 Battle matches.

title: Pinch n Roll Demo
description: About the DemoFlick it. Buff it. Brawl it.Jump into the ridiculous world of Pinch N Roll, an online and local physics-based brawler where you flick, smash and launch your bean through chaotic arenas.Battle your friends, collect powerful buffs and fight for your chance to reach the egg.

title: Beavertale Demo
description: Beavertale demo version

title: Undershroom Demo
description: Take a bite of surreal psychological horror. Explore a world where familiar places twist, reality slips, and your own eyes can't be trusted. Uncover what happened and dare to discover what lies beneath the shroom.

title: Guns of Eschaton Demo
description: A one-of-a-kind soulslike FPS set in an apocalyptic Western. Study who hunts you, count every bullet, fight through death again and again in a standalone adventure crafted just for the demo and offering a concentrated taste of the full game.

title: Temple oF Glyphs Demo
description: Temple of Glyphs is a logic puzzle game. Puzzles governed by enigmatic glyphs await. Decipher the rules and explore the temple.

title: Goddle Demo
description: A demo for the Goddle game!Includes the standard mode, a fixed-size grid and a fixed timer.Have fun!

title: Rekindled: Cozy Tavern Life Demo
description: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

title: Cheese, Please! Demo
description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

title: Dwarf Wars Demo
description: Build armies of witless dwarves and watch them fight their way to victory or fall to their doom in this physics driven, 2D battle simulator!

title: Legion's Hand Demo
description: Legion's Hand is a mahjong-inspired roguelike deckbuilder. Match three identical cards to form a Giant Soldier, or a sequence to form a Regiment. Your hand shapes your army and its formation. Collect 190+ rule-changing relics and send your winning hand into battle.

title: Cinematic Business Demo
description: Run a film studio from screenplay to theatrical release. Hire talent, control budgets, plan marketing and negotiate distribution. The free Cinematic Business demo lets you start up to three film productions over two in-game years.

title: A Bun Above Demo
description: The demo for a physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder. Layers score off their neighbors and every layer adds up — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. The demo gives you three chefs and a four-customer shift.

title: Silicone Heart Demo
description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

title: ChillTank Demo
description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats from scratch: shape the landscape, add water and decorate a home for your fish. Play offline, at your own pace.

title: Crowd Favorites Demo
description: Step into the arena for fame and glory in Crowd Favorites, a 1v1 PvP rogue-lite fighter. Lose a round? Select crazy upgrades and stack them for chaotic synergies to get back at and outsmart your opponent in fast-paced, unpredictable duels!

title: ShirocaTriangle Demo
description: Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game. Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

title: Black Brew Simulator Demo
description: An open world where alcohol is illegal. Produce and sell it, find customers, take over territories, grow your gang, and build a criminal empire — alone or with friends.

title: Incident Reports: Millers Residence Demo
description: You respond to a late-night emergency call and investigate the opening areas of the Millers Residence in this demo. Search rooms, examine evidence, and uncover the clues hidden inside the silent house.

title: Red Lake Demo
description: A psychological horror with no interface to guide you. Only you, the forest, and your notebook. Use it to document static-covered objects and go deeper into the Red Lake — and your past.

title: MAUS TRAP (demo)
description: A gentle adventure platformer about a curious cat finding their place in the world.

title: hexGame: Hero Path Demo
description: Hero Path Demo is a compact version of the adventure. Choose a hero from ordinary NPCs, explore the world, fight enemies, collect equipment, and experience the full gameplay loop through a separate story with limited biomes.

title: Mr Magpie’s Harmless Card Game Demo
description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

title: Biryado Demo
description: Biryado is a billiards roguelike deckbuilder where rules are made to be broken. Collect Billy’s bizarre artefacts, customize your balls with wild abilities and combine their effects into absurd combos. Master shifting tables, overcome eccentric bosses, and send your score into another dimension!

title: HearthFall Demo
description: Build a tavern worth stopping for in the HearthFall Demo. Cook hearty meals, brew your first ales, and welcome travellers into a place of your own. Shape your tavern, meet the locals, and discover the everyday joys of life as an innkeeper.

title: EVERDATE: The Let's Play Dating Game Demo
description: Try EVERDATE’s card game in this free demo, featuring the gameplay tutorial and Free Play. Choose characters and locations, build and edit decks, and challenge AI opponents in matches inspired by the world of Let’s Play.

title: Croak Tales: Deep Dungeons Demo
description: Explore, scavenge and survive ... or croak trying. Dive into murky, abandoned dungeons with your friends to recover an ancient object and reveal the history around this world. It's high-stakes extraction where teamwork is vital, survival is unlikely, and the chaos is half the fun.

title: Meowmunitions Survivor Demo
description: Meowmunitions Survivor is a bullet-heaven arena shooter with the unique augmenting system incorporated from Meowmunitions.

title: Shark Tales: Reef Rogues Demo
description: Ten waves. Two dangerous regions. One gloriously odd crew. Try this underwater survival roguelite solo or with up to four local players: build a ridiculous arsenal, brave two boss battles and see how far your fins can carry you.

title: The Wizard destroying Space and Time Demo
TOBARI and the Vampire Alchemist Demo
description: I want to be your friend. But I want to eat you… Discover the end of a twisted friendship in this story driven adventure. Deep in the forest, an alchemist hides a monster: Tobari. Gather silver coins. Find a cure for an incurable disease.

title: 火の言伝 体験版
description: 物語の序盤（第3章まで）を収録した『火の言伝』発売前体験版です。二つの旅を交互に進めながら、「鍵言葉」を用いた探索や、敵の盾を崩して攻撃の好機を作る戦闘など、本作の基本的なゲームプレイを体験できます。本体験版のセーブデータは、製品版および製品発売後の体験版へ引き継ぐことはできません。

title: Couchpit Demo
description: Couchpit takes the hassle out of couch PC gaming. Open Big Picture or any fullscreen game and it handles the chores: audio, power plan, notifications, background apps. Your gamepad drives Windows, and non-Xbox pads work in Xbox-only games. When you quit, everything goes back to normal.

title: Deflect Demo
description: A bullet hell parry roguelite where your shield is the only weapon. Catch enemy fire and send it screaming back through 100 waves, endless hybrid-boss gauntlets, and a mountain of loot. Seven Reapers, one rule: Don't Shoot, Send it back!

title: Backrooms 95 Demo
description: Explore eerie liminal spaces in a low-poly Backrooms horror experience inspired by the aesthetics of forgotten 90s technology.

title: 帰路 Demo
description: In Chise, an abandoned village overrun by spirits after a ritual talisman was lost, a tsukumogami—an animated Hina doll spirit—and a university student searching for the talisman team up to unravel the mysteries slumbering within this horror exploration adventure.

title: Arcostate Demo
description: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.

title: House Trap Demo
description: Create a hallway, place your traps, try to survive your friends hallway.

title: Nightcup Demo
description: The Nightcup demo: four classics at one table, each of them complete, with every mode and house rule. Dice Poker, No Hard Feelings, Kolonisten and Solitaire, played against the bots. Playing together is in the full game.

title: Endless Valkyrie Demo
description: Endless Valkyrie is a 2D pixel idle RPG inspired by Nordic mythology. Guide a Valkyrie through automatic exploration and combat, configure skills and gear, cross three regions, challenge Bosses, forge equipment, claim Offline Rewards, and Rebirth to preserve permanent growth.

title: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator Demo
description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

title: Primal Tactica Demo
description: Recruit a team of Primals, then equip and evolve them to survive deadly encounters! Loot powerful Relics and Augments and stack synergies to create wild gamebreaking teams. Primal Tactica is a roguelike autobattler where TFT meets Slay the Spire, with thousands of possible builds.

title: Cadence_Blade Demo
description: Hold the castle sword-in-hand in this co-op action defense game for 1-3 players. Time your strikes to the Flow, manage where you invest your coins, and see how long you last against the waves... or just let a friend take the dragon.

title: Cups and Curses Demo
description: Play the first four days of Cups and Curses, a cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks, plan your board around the morning forecast, and get to know the regulars you will need when the Federation comes to your door.

title: Nanoquarium Demo
description: Try the desktop aquarium free. The demo opens the tropical tank: collect and breed its first two tiers of real fish, aquascape it your way, and run the click-through overlay while you work. No clock, no pressure — and your whole tank carries straight into the full game.

title: Rapid Miner Demo
description: Try Rapid Miner for free! Mine ores, upgrade your pickaxe, and experience the desktop overlay Mini Mode. This demo includes the first stage and Mini Mode.

title: 怪谈牌 Demo
description: The last bus takes you into a world of urban horrors. The playing cards in your hand become your means of escape.Deck of Taboos is a poker deckbuilding roguelite. This demo introduces the first act, Rainy South City, where you can experience three-lane card battles, spirit combinations, and card upgrades.

title: Hair Removal Salon Simulator Demo
description: Ready your laser, rev up those trimmers, and run your own hair removal salon! Utilize cutting-edge salon tech, leaving clients hair-free and feeling fresh. Manage their pain levels, launch ludicrous sales pitches, and sink profits into gear upgrades and employees. Become a grooming powerhouse!

title: Literally A Flying Brick : The Ship Building Shooter Demo
description: <Literally A Flying Brick : The Ship Building Shooter> is a bullet heaven game where you can engage in massive space battles by building fully customizable ships. Create your own flying brick and destroy everything that stands in your path.

title: Last Knight ~ Reclaim the Empire ~ Demo
description: Command the last archer knight in a fast pixel-art castle defense. Move with one thumb, gather gold, raise barracks and towers, then send your army to smash the orc horde across a campaign through medieval Britain and beyond. Unlock heroes, masteries and darker magic as you march.

title: Gun Poker Demo
description: Outsmart or outshoot your friends in this poker/FPS hybrid for 2-6 players. Hit better poker hands to get better guns for PvP showdowns in chaotic, destructible arenas. Believe in your cards or your skills and place your bet!

title: Packfall Chain Arena Demo
description: Try Packfall Chain Arena for free. The demo covers Rank V (waves 1-6): clear 4 orbs of the same color and the gear of that color fights, buy and place gear in the shop, link named pairs, and battle turn by turn. Available in 10 languages.

title: Greedspire Demo
description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

title: Blightrole Demo
description: Blightrole is a dice-based game, a role-playing campaign you won’t escape from. Face an original dark fantasy world with a touch of black humor. Will you uncover the Master’s secrets, or will your campaign end before its time?

title: Block Planet Frontier Demo
description: Move freely in eight directions and hit the blocks with the shots fired from your ship to colonize the planet! Collect resources to power up your ship! A pixel-art action shooter.

title: TURF FIGHT Demo
description: Try TURF FIGHT free. A 3D arcade beat 'em up with fighting-game command moves, grabs and parries - this demo includes the full tutorial and stage 1, playable solo or in local co-op for up to 3 players. About 8 minutes.

title: Stuffed: Two Foot Hero Demo
description: 🐻 Protect your owner!Step into the paws of a teddy bear and fight to protect your owner from waves of nightmares invading her dreams. Armed with homemade weapons and defenses, you'll battle through twisted dream worlds in an action-packed VR shooter that blends frantic combat with strategic survival.

title: Form Demo
description: Experience the opening chapter of FORM. Explore the RÆLOS desktop, feed and observe your digital entity, earn resources through quests and minigames, and witness its first three growth phases from SEED to PULSE.

title: Lenin Street Geek Shop Demo
description: Become a shopkeeper in the first geek store in a snowy 2000s town: sell CDs, snacks, and fan merch, influence your customers' lives, get involved in shady business, and grow your small store.

title: AUTOMATE DEATH Demo
description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

title: Fresh Market Simulator Demo
description: Build your own supermarket: order stock, fill shelves and serve customers at checkout. Grow your shop to store level 10 in the demo, customise your shop sign and unlock two additional product licences.

title: Escape: Malice - Friend Pass
description: Escape: Malice is a two-player co-op escape room-style puzzle horror game. Swallowed by a sinkhole, you find yourself trapped in a nightmarish Japanese mansion haunted by a sinister presence. Solve twisted puzzles, uncover dark secrets, make unforgiving choices, and descend deeper to escape Malice…

title: Swinging Pier Clean Simulator Demo
description: Swing between skyscrapers on a co-op cleaning crew's precarious scaffold, blast years of grime away with foam and pressure washers, and try not to send your teammates flying. Solo zen or 4-player chaos — the choice is yours

title: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings Demo
ONE MAN'S DECEIT Demo
description: This is a survival horror first-person game where you are on a mission to find a missing friend. In your quest to find him, you realized you were fooled by another friend, and the whole trip is a lie. He is now blackmailing you throughout the journey. Will you follow his words or be on your own?

title: CLAWSTROPHOBIA Demo
description: You are trapped underground in a Japanese subway station and must pay off an impossible debt in this rogue-lite claw machine deckbuilder.

title: PUCKVPUCK Demo
description: Arcade sports with pucks. Boost, slam and charge your shots in SOCCER, knock the other team out in DODGEBALL, or grab a gun in SHOOTER. Up to 8 players on one PC, online with friends, or solo against bots.

title: Hotel 13 Demo
description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

title: BugPot Demo
description: BugPot is a casual roguelike where every spin shapes the fight. Match weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, build powerful combinations and adapt your strategy as you face a bizarre variety of bugs.

title: YOU IN? Demo
description: Try YOU IN?, a top-down bullet-hell roguelite for solo or 2-player online co-op. Evolve your weapons through powerful Mutations, combine Traits to shape your build, and defeat bosses to claim their attack patterns.

title: RATSHOT Demo
description: RATSHOT is a fast paced 2D platformer where you use the recoil of your gun to launch yourself through levels. Hone your speedrunning skills to get the best times and ranks, or play at your own pace and admire the graffiti-covered walls of NYC. This is the demo.

title: The Hostel Project Demo
description: Run your own Edinburgh backpacker hostel in this cozy management sim demo. Start from humble beginnings and grow your hostel to be the most legendary, or infamous, spot in town. Host influencers, pub crawls, and complete sponsorships to build your fame and achieve that prestigious 10/10 rating.

title: Field Surgeon Demo
description: Scrub in as a field surgeon in a plague-ridden free city at war. Humans, dwarves, elves, orcs, hornfolk and giants come to your table. Draw arrows from bone, close sabre cuts, saw shattered limbs, and face the Malison: a curse that fights back from inside your patients.

title: Applied Shamanism Demo
description: A cozy 3D game about a rookie rabbit shaman. Diagnose quirky illnesses with X-ray spirit vision, gather and grow elemental ingredients, and brew always-useful potions. Each patient is a bite-size mystery of folk ailments and guardian spirits, with no combat, damage, or timers.

title: Clown Around Demo
description: You are a clown! Clown Around is an immersive sim FPS where your job is to explore large open levels to identify and prank targets working to rid the world of fun. Choose your loadout from an arsenal of wacky clown tools and insane perks that wildly change your playstyle. How you play is up to you!

title: Cats and Hats Demo
description: Stack Hats on adorable Cats. A cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder where you match tiles, build multis, and stack Hats on a variety of oddly compliant Cats.

title: Mixed Martial Cards Demo
description: Mixed martial arts-themed card battle game - design a deck and strategy to beat up your opponent across standing-up and grappling fighting. Practice with bots, play with friends or the community.

title: Skysunder Demo
description: An auto-battler fought on floating isles. Draft from 64 units across 8 races, kit them with over 60 relics, item upgrades, and unique unit modifiers called imprints! Strategize by giving every squadron its orders, and casting spells in real-time to change the battle!

title: Her Crown of Blood Demo
description: A sinful child is damned to hell. Her religious mother follows her. A demo for an indie horror RPG.

title: Unbox Super Card Demo
description: Buy CardBoxes, reveal valuable cards, build your automated opening factory, and Prestige to grow your fortune even faster. Complete every collection and become the ultimate card collector.

title: THE FIGHT BUSINESS: BOXING MANAGER Demo
description: Try THE FIGHT BUSINESS: BOXING MANAGER and get hands-on with the business of boxing. Manage fighters and contracts, make fights, build events and navigate a persistent world of rankings, championships and rival promotions.

title: ELDRITCH SLAYER Demo
description: The ELDRITCH SLAYER Demo is now available! Experience three levels of introductory combat in this retro FPS filled with bloodshed and dark humor!

title: Double Down & Out Demo
description: The house always wins, so change the rules. Double Down & Out is blackjack where you combine cards and maths to reach your target. Stack buffs, enhance your cards with chips and beat down dealers who play by their own rules.

title: Football Academy Simulator Demo
description: Manage your own football academy! Create personalized training programs to develop your players, clean and repair equipment, run your sports store, and use your earnings to expand your facilities.

title: Hack You Demo
description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

title: Count Your Sins Demo
description: In this demo, you can experience daily campus life, character interactions, branching choices, and key plot events, while witnessing the evolving relationship between Situ Yang and Su Ying.

title: Clean Tides Demo
description: A cozy ocean-cleaning game where every haul builds a better boat. Sail a sunny bay, collect litter, clear oil spills, and power-wash coral reefs. Sell your haul to upgrade and customize your boat, hire cleanup crews, and feed coastal wildlife. Bring a little sparkle back to the sea at your own pace.

title: Harvest Overdrive Demo
description: Grow crops, build your farm, and survive 20 waves of monsters in the Harvest Overdrive demo. Combine seeds, weapons, scrolls, and livestock as you harvest, fulfill orders, and battle bosses.

title: 栀子与荆棘 Demo
description: 上一份工作逝去后，普通少女陈栀子莫名其妙被娱乐公司招走，本以为是好运降临，但很快她就发现，这几个天赋异禀的队友......成分有点复杂！ 在游戏中，您将跟随陈栀子的视角，展开一段惊喜与惊吓并存的旅程，而您的选择，将决定这场梦幻喜剧的结局。本DEMO包含了游戏开头的故事，希望大家体验愉快~

title: Zynthex Demo
description: Build an alien-drug business on a remote colony. Grow strange crops, experiment with mixtures and find customers while avoiding the police. Explore a hostile world for supplies, fight mutants and aliens. Play solo or team up with friends.

title: Bun G Bop Demo
description: Bun G Bop is a low-stakes high-chaos co-op platformer about flinging your friend with a bungee cord while tagging a big tower. We built this game to be fun for all duos, even ones who suck at platformers.

title: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation Demo
Monster Farm Simulator Demo
description: This is the Demo version of Monster Farm Simulator. It Contains the 3 main game modes, disconnected, and with limited content. The Farm section has no saving feature for the demo. The Factory section and Delivery section are setup as arcade modes. The Farm and Delivery sections are coming soon.

title: Run Man: Wash The Dish Demo
TsundereSQL Demo
description: Try the first five SQL exercises of TsundereSQL. Write real DuckDB queries, pass hidden tests, and meet Tsumugi, the demanding instructor, in a playable slice of the anime visual novel SQL course. Free, no account, runs offline.

title: Gimbap Heaven Demo
description: Toss cards, roll kimbap, serve customers! Try Day 1-7 in the Gimbap Heaven demo. Experience the core systems of this card-based restaurant management sim.

title: Gravefever Demo
description: The free demo of Gravefever. Punch, shoot and freeze your way through endless monster hordes, build your hunter from branching skills and capstones, and topple two mega bosses. Clear it as fast as you can and race the world on the demo leaderboards.

title: Zone Idle Demo
description: The Zone Idle demo opens the first two maps of the Zone, Cordon and Factory, with the hideout, traders, quests, CORTEX automation and operatives that unlock as you level. Red Forest, Labs and Mirage are visible but locked, and prestige is not available in the demo.

title: Nosteria Demo
description: <Nosteria> is a 2D platformer set in a steampunk fantasy world. Once a garden where precious memories grew into beautiful flowers and trees, it has turned into cold, ash-gray ruins by an unknown shadow. Embark on a journey with a young boy to bring color back to this world.

title: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle Demo
description: Every hand must win. Try ALL-HU, a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up. This demo includes the full beginner course, the tutorial, the story prologue, the first tier of 2- and 4-hand puzzles and 12 Gambit boards. The full game has 1,100+ puzzles.

title: Just Make Sense: Instinct Lab Demo
description: Free demo of Just Make Sense (Instinct Lab): two instincts fully unlocked — Area and Timing — across five difficulty tiers. Cut exact proportions, feel the seconds pass; most rounds resolve in 15 seconds. Main mode, random runs and a codex. No trivia, no math — just your gut.

title: SIDExLINES Demo
description: SIDExLINES is a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder where you'll utilize synergistic side bets and playing card combos to beat increasing wager requirements and run-ending pit bosses.

title: Omenweald : Les Erres Demo
description: demo : A top-down pixel-art roguelite action-RPG. Feed fragments torn from defeated foes to an unhinged brass one-armed bandit, with it, stack the sewers you're about to raid, then fight your way out with the loot — or lose it all. Chain expeditions as long as you dare.

title: For God and For Profit Demo
Tamer Survivors Demo
description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

title: The Judges' Quandary: Chimera Protocol
description: Create chimeras by combining the HEAD, BODY, and LIMBS of test subjects, then challenge judges with different evaluation criteria. The demo lets you experience the core gameplay using a selection of test subjects and judges.

title: Italia 1915–1918 : Great War Logistics Demo
description: A turn-based management game set in WWI: command an Italian Army camp, upgrade its buildings, manage men and resources, and keep your unit alive through day and night, turn after turn, as the front line draws ever closer.

title: Cricket Club President Demo
description: A cricket club management game where you are the president, not the coach. The demo is one full season: pick three sides every week from one squad, keep the captain and the committee onside, then face the AGM vote. The career you start here carries into the full game.

title: Goreticulture Demo
description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through expansive levels, earning perks to move faster and jump higher as you use the blood to grow helpful plants. Combining cleaning with farming, Goreticulture is a simulator unlike any other!

title: [Nightmare Files] Stoned Demo
description: In this short horror game, you take on the role of the ship’s mechanic, recruited for an expedition led by an ambitious archaeologist who claims to have found a map to a forgotten island.

title: ZOMBILLIONAIRE Demo
description: Incremental FPS game where Millions of Zombies came from the dead... AND THEY ARE FULL OF OIL!!!!!! Demolish Millions of Zombies. Buy Insane Weapons. and become a Zombie Oil Billionaire

title: Hamsuri : Bomb Festival Demo
description: Pocket a bomb, outwit your rivals, and spark an instant rematch in this free hamster arena demo. Play solo against CPU or locally with friends across two festival arenas and two rule sets. English interface.

title: Number Machine: Math Factory Demo
description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

title: Diceminoes Demo
description: Diceminoes is a score-chasing roguelike where you roll dice, pair them up to make dominoes, and connect them into scoring patterns. Discover powerful upgrades, bend the rules, and turn clever placements into huge scoring cascades.

title: Project Nebula Demo
description: An explosive arcade arena shooter inspired by the golden age of Amiga classics. Blast through asteroid fields, destroy alien forces, upgrade your ship, and unleash devastating weapons in a modern reimagining of a timeless genre.

title: Doctor Moore's World of Creatures Demo
I HATE trees, so an ANCIENT VAMPIRE hired me to DESTROY EVERY last ONE Demo
description: An ancient vampire hired you to destroy every tree on an island. Chop, burn, automate the logging and turn it into cash. Along the way, uncover the island's secrets, meet its eccentric residents and try not to anger your employer.

title: BLUEBELL Demo
description: The demo for BLUEBELL.It contains the entirety of Book 1, Chapter 1.

title: Horror Game Creator Demo
description: Build your own nightmare in Horror Game Creator! Design eerie environments, place enemies, add jump scares, and give players a chance to fight back. This demo includes limited content, with additional items available in the full version.

title: Zombie Lab Demo
description: Experiment on your own undead test subject in Zombie Lab! Study regeneration, test strength, monitor mood, and push its limits with injections, electricity, crushers, and crash tests. Try the 15-minute demo, with more content available in the full version.

title: Spell Death Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where the alphabet is your deck. Draw letters and spell words to strike, block or hex. Print them on paper stocks that change the rules, and learn each demon's true name to banish it from an art deco city that stopped reading.

title: EternalCircuitBoard Demo
description: Place chips on a 6×6 board and build circuits that generate energy. Completed circuits keep working every turn and can become part of the next one. Grow your board within a limited number of turns and reach the target score.

title: Pray & Slay Demo
description: Experience Stage 1 of Pray & Slay. Slay monsters with holy spells in this active incremental game. Multiply your gold with darts and corrupt your spells to unleash their more powerful dark forms.

title: Gin Rummy: Pixel Cardroom Demo
description: Play Classic Gin Rummy in the Pixel Cardroom Demo. Draw, discard, knock, or go Gin. Choose your opening seed and independently verify the game record. More variants await in the full game.

title: Wildfire Command '98 Demo
description: A real-time wildfire command sim. You are the air attack supervisor: read the wind, the slope and the fuel, then draw the lines your tankers and helicopters fly. This demo is three complete fires from the full game.

title: Letters from the Springs Demo
description: Open the doors of a quiet mountain inn.Letters from the Springs is a cozy inn management game about caring for travelers and finding your own rhythm. This demo includes the opening story and seven in-game business days, beginning with your first reservation letter.

title: RushGirl LUCA Demo
description: RushGirl LUCA is a one-handed roguelite shooter — Dodge and fire through the swarm, and rebuild your arsenal between waves. Be your own bullet heaven.

title: Kleopatra Zero Demo
description: The free demo: the first two chapters of KLEOPATRA ZERO, both bosses included. A fast-paced mech wave-shooter and a standalone prequel to Kleopatra, with every enemy attack drawn on the floor before it lands and a card choice before each wave to build a chain that clears the screen.

title: STARSHIP: EMBER REACH Demo
