description: Build a modular warship, choose from 20 weapons, and command independent weapon groups in six-degree-of-freedom combat. Inspect your ship, salvage wrecks, collect cards, and turn recovered materials into upgrades in this free single-player demo.

title: Shoot First Ask Questions Later Demo
description: Listen Carefully! We don't have much time. Shoot First, Ask Questions Later! Is that clear?

title: Hush Piñata Demo
description: Cansada de apanhar, ela vendou os próprios olhos e voltou sedenta por vingança. Neste jogo de festa de terror e comédia para até 9 jogadores, a Piñata vendada caça pelo som — e até mesmo a sua voz no microfone faz uma silhueta brilhar na escuridão dela. Realize as tarefas em silêncio e arranque o rabo dela antes que ela perceba.

title: IWA Fighting Adventure Demo
description: A DEMO where you can experience the early stages of the game and defeat bosses in the first two regions!

title: SMOKE HAVEN Demo
description: Build a smoking haven for free in the Roadside stage. Place furniture, ashtrays and cafe equipment, welcome regulars, and manage cleaning and defense. Keep playing after clearing it and transfer your save to the full game on the same PC. Free Mode is not included.

title: UNIT-5000 Demo
description: UNIT-5000 is a top-down extraction roguelite bullet hell where you build a combat mech and fight alien invaders. Experiment with weapons and modules, face hordes and multi-phase bosses, extract resources before a run goes wrong, and use them to unlock deadlier builds for the next fight.

title: Whispers Demo
description: Whispers is a psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned hospital, investigate its dark secrets, and follow the final footage of a missing vlogger. Listen for unsettling whispers, uncover clues, and navigate a reality where you can no longer trust what you see or hear.

title: On Any Journey Demo
description: On Any Journey is a co-op adventure built around constantly evolving ways to play together. Help each other, get in each other’s way, and adapt on the fly as new mechanics change the rules of cooperation. Play locally or online, and invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass.

title: System Critical 3 Demo
description: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for VR.

title: Stranding Demo
description: You play as Yu Xiao, a freelance artist scraping by on commissions after losing your job.Clients keep sending revision after revision. Your mother calls to deliver her habitual put-downs. And you — prone to spiraling thoughts rooted in your family of origin — can't help but spiral.

title: Childrens Story Demo
description: Childrens Story is an Anthological Horror Game. Made up of a growing collection of short-form Horror Stories. Each story offers a unique experience which will transport you to a time and place far from the here and now. Enter at your own risk. Leave at your own pace.

title: Dirt & Viscera: The Great War Demo
Counting Sand in the Sahara Demo
description: Just how many grains of sand are there in the Sahara? If you want to know it, then you’ll have to count it!

title: 螺丝钉 Screw Demo
description: Sci-Fi x Lesbian x Visual Novel! "螺丝钉 Screw" is a sci-fi lesbian visual novel. You will play as a company intern who is about to undergo a probationary period review, and decide your own future within a short week.

title: Beyond The Abandoned Demo
description: Climb through the shifting realms of your mind, confronting hazards, enemies, and risky decisions on your ascent to regain consciousness.

title: ARCHSCROLL Demo
description: An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments! This is a demo build.

title: Three Kingdoms Story Demo
description: Choose a faction, recruit officers, raise troops, and conquer rival strongholds across board-style maps in large-scale real-time battles.

title: Needle Guardian 〜針の番人〜 Demo
description: Unravel, awaken, defend. A tower defense of plushies. Unravel the cotton walls to open paths, and plush friends spring to life to hold back the invaders on their own. There is only one thing you must never lose: the core - a heart. Nine soft, faintly eerie layers of the mind are waiting.

title: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal Demo
Drillbot Delver Demo
description: Drillbot Delver is a roguelike mystery-dungeon style mining game where you traverse through a variety of pre-made and randomly generated floors, fighting enemies and collecting resources while trying to find the exit.

title: HUMONGOUS Tree Growing Simulator Demo
description: Build a Human Blood Extraction Factory! It's an incremental TD + Roguelike where your main goal is to torture little corpsys for Blood. Expand your towers and keep building upwards to reach different areas and fight boss and enemy waves, until your tree reaches heaven.

title: Diorama Tactics Demo
description: Build your team, place your units, and watch them fight automatically in this strategic roguelite auto-battler. Collect powerful heroes, master the board, survive challenging battles, and grow your collection as you push deeper into the game.

title: Grimrain Demo
description: Grimrain is an indie MMORPG with a variety of casual and challenging gameplay for solo and groups. Explore the game world, with gathering, crafting, instanced and overworld dungeons, player housing and decoration, hidden locations, and legendary foes.

title: Cross Contamination Demo
description: Cross Contamination is a fast-paced melee beat-em-up inspired by old school early playstation era classics, take control of the Half-Mutant Lucan Cross to clear the city of all of the disgusting mutants infecting it and attempt to find a cure!

title: Dream City Psyche Demo
description: Dream City Psyche is an open world investigation focused urban role playing game. You're a psychic born with a mission to find your missing uncle on a small island, Dream City. Investigate murders, find missing journal entries and unlock psychic abilities to unravel entities from another dimension.

title: HAFO: Horse Around, Find Out Demo
The Veiled Atlas: A Cycle of Falls Demo
description: A turn-based 4X of rival governments contesting the dim Atlas through economy, war and an Influence-weighted Council. You can win every battle and still lose the vote.

title: Heliobane Demo
description: The free demo of HELIOBANE: the first three stages of World 1, from the Tharsis Belt to Admiral Husk. Build your first loadout at the Magpie, learn the Breaker, and see if the Amiga-style shoot 'em up is for you. The demo keeps its own save.

title: Path Of Peecho Demo
description: Trailer coming soon! Fight the Pawtriarchy! The world has been dominated by the greediest cat the universe has ever known. Assemble your team of rebels, build their decks, customize their skill trees, and take Peecho down in this turn-based roguelite scramble to save humanity right meow.

title: Close Enough Demo
description: Draw your way through a physics puzzle platformer, even when your doodle is mistaken for something else. Try stages 1-1 to 1-5 with guided tutorials, solo or in two-player online co-op. Keyboard and mouse required.

title: Gridiron Grit: Pro Football Dynasty Simulator Demo
CarSim Racing Demo
description: CarSim Racing is a racing game where you start from the very bottom with regular cars and work your way up to supercars, competing against the best racers!The game features more than 45 cars across different classes. Each vehicle is unique and has its own strengths and weaknesses.

title: Clash of Crests Demo
description: The old king is dead and the ravens circle. Ride with Sir Roland through The Raven's War - five battles and an interlude of turn-based medieval tactics on hex battlefields, with Saxon, Norman and Saracen troops to command.

title: DODGE(Y)BALL Demo
description: Quick online 1v1 dodgeball with charged throws, dashing, catching, blocking and active parries. Outsmart your opponent across two arenas with two ball types in this demo of DODGE(Y)BALL.

title: Space Postal Service Demo
description: Fly from planet to planet delivering mail to the folks who live on these tiny worlds. Get to know them, just be sure not to read the mail. Chill out and fly around this hand drawn, 2.5D simulated solar system, earn money for your deliveries while collecting stamps to fill your notebook.

title: The Demon Lurking in Osaka Castle – Episode 1 Demo
The Proxy Demo
description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

title: No Survivors Demo
description: Become the slasher in an over-the-top 1980s horror movie. Hunt campers across Camp Crestwood, unlock nine brutal weapons, weaponize a fully destructible map, and survive an escalating response in this free playable slice of No Survivors.

title: GuGuGaGa-DeskPet Demo
description: The little penguin that shakes its head and makes that goofy "GuGuGaGa" sound – a viral meme across the internet – has now come to your desktop! Different interactions will trigger her unique reactions – after all, she is that very meme penguin with all those expressive emotes!

title: Oops, No Floor! Demo
description: Play the Oops, No Floor! Demo solo or with up to three friends. Steal the Clockheart, carry it through a dangerous factory, and build your escape route using a shared supply of portable floor panels.

title: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop Demo
description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

title: Clickore Station Demo
description: Defend your station with a click and survive as long as you can. Destroy the enemies, mine the deposit, then trade your ore for permanent upgrades. Every world has its own ore, its own enemies and its own rules.

title: Fleshbound Demo
description: Experience the opening chapter of FLESHBOUND in this atmospheric first-person horror demo. Explore a mysterious house during a violent storm and uncover the first signs of its dark secret.

title: Immerse Gamepack FINAL FANTASY™ XIV Online Edition Demo
description: Immerse Gamepack FINAL FANTASY XIV is an official add-on for FFXIV. Developed by Embody in collaboration with the FFXIV sound team, this software allows you to experience 360 object-based spatial audio in FFXIV with your own personalized HRTF with ANY headphone.

title: Spot the Difference Stadium Demo
description: Find the one that doesn't belong. A board packed with near-identical characters hides a single odd one out — spot it fast, alone or against up to 8 players online.

title: Spell Fist Demo
description: Unleash fists of arcane fury in this boss-rush brawler. Punch, parry, and steal spells as a broke wizard fighting rival mages to escape crushing debt.

title: Dude, Trust Me Demo
description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

title: Desk Hunter Demo
description: Try Desk Hunter, a single-player idle RPG with no player trading. Hunt in a compact desktop window, collect gear, and build around skills, growth nodes, scrolls, and familiars. Explore 30 Normal stages and reach hunter level 30.

title: DEEPWARD Demo
description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

title: ANIMITE : Echoes of the Chasm Demo
description: Fight alongside your wolf companion in this turn-based tactical game using gunfire and elemental reactions! Master positioning and elemental bullets. Harvest enemy ingredients to cook and sell from your food truck, but first, survive a grueling extraction phase against massive swarms!

title: Terminal Depth Demo
description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

title: bet you won't Demo
description: Bet You Won't is a story-driven first-person horror game where you play a livestream unboxer targeted by a killer. Inspect the disturbing packages they send you, decide what to open, uncover hidden clues, and piece together the truth — but be careful. Some packages should never be opened.

title: Hit the Anvil Demo
description: Strike the anvil, forge rare gear, and build your legacy in a pixel-art incremental crafting game.

title: Nostalgiallo Demo
description: A small peek into a surreal point-and-click with vote-based combat, taking place in a corrupted world based on Spanish "Tebeo" slapstick comics.

title: MNOZ - My Nuclear Octopus 2 Demo
description: Everyone's favourite nuclear octopus is back to save the world again in MNOZ, the explosive sequel to the hit game My Nuclear Octopus. MNOZ is a psychedelic retro arcade game for fans of pure out-and-out arcade blasters. Chase those online high scores! And if you have a VR headset, play in VR!

title: Purrfect Beats Demo
description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

title: The Bakery Demo
description: Create your own bakery on your own or with up to 3 of your friends. Unlock new recipes, kitchen furniture, decorations and more. Keep your bakery running as long as you can, the more reputation your bakery gains the more popular it becomes, will you be able to handle the demand?

title: Desmarchon Demo
description: Try Desmarchon's chain-weaving combat across four Campaign operations. Play Weaver, Carrier or Gunship, craft gear and shape a compact talent tree, then push endless Shardwake. Extract with your cargo or risk it all.

title: Deepstrata Demo
description: Fly your mining pod into the crust of Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto. Drill deep, haul ore up, and pour the profits into your rig. Fuel always burns, hulls crack, and something old is awake down there. A 2D mining adventure with a story campaign, base building and a living ore market.

title: Five to Fire Demo
description: A showdown of quick hands! The instant the table holds exactly five bullets, hit the lever and load your revolver. Shoot down every rival and survive as a gunslinging legend. A real-time multiplayer party game for 2-6 players.

title: The Night Kitchen Demo
description: The Night Kitchen is a psychological horror game. You just started a new job - the night shift in a kitchen. Grill, oven, deep fryer. Take orders, prepare the food, talk to the customer. Simple work. Seven nights. Each one stranger than the last.

title: Handful of Dice Demo
description: Try the tactile digital dice tray for tabletop gamers. Pick up and throw physics-driven dice, watch them settle, then read the results. Save favorite hands and try custom dice in the Workshop. Saving custom dice pouches is part of the full game.

title: 火箭工厂 Rocket Factory Demo
Street Takeover Demo
description: Drive Fast. Pit Harder. Takeover. Street Takeover is a racing game about high speed police chases, wrecked and damaged car physics, and taking on the county from the racer's seat or leading it's police force in cleaning up the town.

title: GOAT - Gear Optimization Auto-Battle Tactics Demo
description: An evil goat stole all your clothes. Win them back piece by piece, auto-battle goats, create powerful gear combos, and find absurd synergies in this dress-up roguelike auto-battler.

title: Fly Chicken Fly Demo
description: Run, dodge, and launch your way to freedom! Evade angry farmers, collect scrap components across the farm, and construct a makeshift catapult to propel yourself over the fences before you get caught.

title: Murmuring of Moth Mouth Demo
description: Yuna is driving to the interview that could change her life when an eleven-year-old video shows her car from moments ago. Begin a journey of impossible recordings and unsettling directions in this demo of Murmuring of Moth Mouth, a psychological horror visual novel.

title: Long Voyage Demo
description: Sail toward a new continent with eight other crew members. Survive the first days of the voyage, manage limited food and water, fish for supplies, and face illness, theft, and growing tension on board.

title: VIVID Demo
description: Be a dandelion in a mixed forest and get your first glimpse of VIVID, a cozy, narrative-driven plant survival simulation about nature, responsibility, and interconnected systems. Grow over time, experience random events, and play as the seeds you produce.

title: Louloudi Asteri ~Save the Solar System~ Demo
description: Switch between two fighter aces in this 3D side-scrolling shooter! Roll your ship to rotate the screen, revealing gaps in enemy fire and terrain. Life regenerates over time, and the frontal shield blocks all fire. Lock on, use special weapons, and sidestep through 3D space to save the solar system!
developer: AETHANTOS 星花🌸ゲーム開発, 星花

title: MAEVOR Demo
description: Ride through the dark woods as a priest hunted by a winged demon. Use your crucifix to repel the creature and survive the journey. This demo highlights Maevor’s tension, atmosphere, and 3D positional audio.

title: Cranked Demo
description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

title: Hunters Origin Demo
description: Oldshool MMORPG foundations, sprinkled with modern gameplay! Hunt dangerous beasts, claim legendary loot, and customize your build with deep skill trees. Develop your hub at Archer’s Pond, craft gear, collect rare mounts, and forge your own legend alongside other players!

title: BRASSWIND BRIGADE
description: Drive tanks, pilot vintage aircraft, and build your own brigade in a single-player war RPG with real-time combat and tactical pause. Join Haiyan, a self-proclaimed princess, recruit companions through the story, collect vehicles, and craft upgrades on the road to liberating the kingdom.

title: Echoes Below Demo
description: Descend into the depths of the ocean and explore an underwater world alongside a mysterious octopus. Together, you will discover marine creatures and uncover the mysteries that await at the bottom of the sea…

title: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager Demo
Plasma Sky Demo
description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

title: Dronefall Demo
description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

title: FGD - Forever Grind Dungeon Demo
description: A turn-based, first-person dungeon crawler in the spirit of Bard's Tale. This free demo lets you play dungeon levels 1 to 4 and face the level-4 boss with a party of four from 8 races and 10 classes.

title: Feather's Edge Demo
description: Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

title: 西洋飞行棋：Ludo Mosaic Demo
description: Try a complete classic two-player Ludo match on the Jiangnan Water Town board. Play against the computer, bring your four pieces home, and start as many new matches as you like. Demo matches do not use coins or purchases. Choose your own random seed before a match.

title: Necromancer Incremental Graveyard Demo
description: Make undead, sell them for souls. An active incremental game where you make as much soul as possible to pay debt. Upgrade multiple different undead gravestones, use contracts, fill up soul jar and unlock perks to make even more souls

title: Colorsong Demo
description: Every color is a note. Drops fall, burst, and pay for a wider palette. The paint fills a gallery of hand-painted watercolors, and the song grows with the palette. Click along, or let it run.

title: STACKPUNK Demo
description: STACKPUNK is a steampunk falling-block roguelite. Stack bricks, clear lines, and choose powerful reward cards to shape your run. Then face bosses who keep changing the rules of the job. Familiar pieces. Unreasonable management.

title: Lost Hope Demo
description: Lost Hope is a short, First person Atmospheric walking simulator set in the distant future, in the deep space, a lone man tries to survive and get a cure for mankind.

title: Disconnected Demo
description: Step into the shoes of Robex, a streamer trapped in a deadly Urbex. Use your smartphone to solve puzzles, manage a reactive chat, and escape a relentless presence. Disconnected is a photorealistic horror experience designed to be completed in one sitting. Will you survive the stream?

title: KUTO: The Lock of Time Demo
Epsilon Hyperpunk Demo
description: Enter a cyber world in this On-Rails space shooter. You are a lone K.I.L.L.E.R. facing an impossible mission in a decaying dystopian future. Your only edge? Running high-stakes combat simulations through a NEUROVISOR powered by a highly illegal, custom-built Operating System-- HyperpunkOS.

title: Black Pyramid Demo
description: Black Pyramid is an interactive cinematic game largely brought to life by AI‑generated visuals. Cursed by an ancient force, Ethan must venture to the fabled forbidden Black Pyramid in search of his only chance for survival.

title: 南亭湖 Dependent Origination Demo
description: A state machinery plant is haunted by a dismemberment murder. A girl's vanishing and a fatal plunge fuel ghost rumors. Years later, cop Wang Nan uncovers the truth: fates interwoven over a decade reveal human guilt and redemption—not spectral revenge.
developer: 船Chuan Studio（杭州半自觉游戏科技）

title: Fading Edge Demo
description: You wake inside a dream that keeps falling. Inhale, and the world slows; exhale, and you start to run. But every breath stirs deeper nightmares — they remember you, and you do not remember yourself. Gather the echoes, piece your memory back together — or stay in this dark forever.

title: Firework Store Simulator Demo
description: Manage your own fireworks store in Tokyo! Buy, sell, and ignite dazzling fireworks, organize spectacular night shows, and craft custom pyrotechnics in this cozy simulation game. Build your small shop into the city's ultimate fireworks empire!

title: Misnomers by Nick Oueijan Demo
description: A preposterous word game where you create a recursive language, one word at a time! Laugh (or cry) as you define each word from other words and your decisions snowball beyond expectations. Decipher definitions, discover drawings, then use your save file to translate the internet!

title: The Final Stamp Demo
description: Meet Bob Weaver, a truck driver who died in a car crash. Hear his side of the story, learn to use your investigative tools, and see the case through to a verdict. The demo includes one case with a guided tutorial, from the first document to the final stamp.

title: Return to Campus II: Billionaire Heir Goes to School Demo
description: A UE5 open-world comedy game. Play as a super-rich kid who is accidentally transported from a modern city to a medieval world. Explore both eras, complete quests, interact with NPCs, drive around, start fights, and enjoy a free and absurd time-travel adventure.

title: Bookish Buddies: Bookstore Simulator Demo
description: Manage a cozy bookstore with up to 4 friends! By day, stock shelves and serve customers. But beware the Night Shift—grab your magic wands to defend your shop against creatures and survive the hilarious chaos in this unique co-op simulator.

title: Backrooms Insane Demo
description: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

title: DichrowarMelee Demo
description: A 2D pixel-art asynchronous PvP auto-battler. Build and refine your team through PvE dungeons to earn gear and progression, shape unique builds via skill trees and equipment synergies, and compete against other players’ teams in asynchronous PvP battles.

title: Void Inc Demo
description: Try 14 in-game days of a darkly funny workplace management sim with creeping horror. Plan the workload, clear emails to the beat, and decide who gets the coffee. Keep the CEO happy and your sanity intact. You're on the schedule too.

title: Odd Express Demo
description: Discover the rules of the anomaly and survive the night. A mystery horror game set aboard a long-distance train. Explore the train and gather clues during the day, then prepare for the night. Deduce the anomaly's behavior, survive seven days, and make it to the final station.

title: 全小将 Demo
description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

title: Door Code Demo
description: A demo of a puzzle game where you remember and arrange panels to create letters and find a way to escape from a mysterious building.

title: Road to FIRE Demo
description: A demo of a challenging puzzle game where you analyze the rules of deadly games, uncover hidden winning strategies, and fight to survive.

title: Marry Anyone Demo
description: A demo of a matchmaking puzzle game where you change your stats, use items, and find a way to get married within one month.

title: SLOW ORBIT: Idle Planet Conquest Demo
description: Slow Orbit puts a tiny, self-running space war in the bottom corner of your screen. Leave your fleet to conquer planets while you do other things, then drop in to buy upgrades, pick promotions and take on tougher defenses.

title: Mournwake: Across the Styx Demo
description: The dead pay. The rivers never rest. Become Charon in a story-driven dark fantasy roguelike. Earn your coin ferrying souls, brave the rivers of the Greek underworld, and build temples to grow your power and income. Discover why the inhabitants of Hades have turned against their ferryman.

title: Tunnel Brawl Friend Pass Demo
description: Join a friend who owns Tunnel Brawl and play complete underground tank duels for free. One owner can invite one Friend Pass guest into the same lobby and 1v1 match. Practise solo, then dig, flank and fight in the same arena.

title: Shit-Stealing Gnomes Demo
description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

title: Wove Demo
description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

title: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find Demo
Guild Manager Demo
description: You are the guild master. In a world ravaged by gates, recruit the Awakened and raise them to protect what remains.

title: Quadrex Demo
description: Quadrex is a mass chaos first-person shooter battle sandbox. This is a single-player game where every bot you shoot will go flying through the air! Pick your bot count, time limit, and rack up kills until the time runs out!

title: SpudFall Demo
description: Blast your way through Level 1 of this real-time potato artillery brawl. Aim, charge and fire all at once against AI spuds or up to 3 friends on the couch, with 3 special weapons and destructible terrain. Can you top the leaderboard?

title: Realm Nine Demo
description: On the land of Jiuzhou, fragments of your stolen Spirit Wings are hidden. You will assume the roles of five supernatural beings capable of real-time transformations, embarking on a journey to reclaim the lost fragments.

title: Rebelote : Belote & Coinche – Friend Pass
description: The Friend Pass lets you invite up to 3 friends to join your online Belote and Coinche card games completely free. They can play multiplayer matches with you at no cost — no purchase required, invite-only.

title: Marble Mill Demo
description: The first era of Marble Mill — about 25 minutes, ending right where it gets good. Build the mill, hear it chime, melt it down once.

title: When Pigs Fly Demo
description: Build the plane while you're flying it with 3 friends! Grapple scrap, bolt it onto your cart, and transform into a plane mid-flight. Dodge wolves, fall constantly, and get to the destination island before the whole thing comes apart.

title: Cyber Ninja: Tokyo Rumble Demo
description: Become a cyber ninja in this high-speed VR action demo. Parry robotic enemies, strike back with 3 melee weapons, and form hand seals to unleash a devastating ninja technique. Test your skills in the training hub, then battle through 2 combat stages.

title: Engagement Demo
description: One capital ship. Fifteen minutes until relief. Bolt salvaged guns onto your hull, raise a fleet of named escorts who rank up and branch, and hold the lane against a Hollow swarm that grows every minute you survive.

title: Headshot Holdout Demo
description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Does it need to be more complicated? Well... there is a bit more than that… Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way through a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold.

title: MMA Tactics - Martial Arts Demo
description: A tactical turn-based MMA simulation with (optional auto-battle) and perma-death. From your backyard to a world title. Recruit Fighters, Assign Perks, Train Stats, Build Synergies, Manage Injuries, Unlock strategies, Upgrade your Gym, Bribe the Commission and create a roster of MMA Champions.

title: A Drop of Magenta Demo
description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

title: Baskets and Blooms Demo
description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

title: Redline Horde Demo
description: Redline Horde is a high-octane vehicular action roguelike. Drive, drift, and survive against relentless swarms of enemy cars. Upgrade your weapons, collect XP gems, and build the ultimate combat machine in this intense bullet heaven on wheels. Can you outrun the horde?

title: One More Floor Demo
description: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

title: The Lighthouse Whispers Demo
description: In this atmospheric, slow-burn horror, you must unravel the mystery of the disappearance of your fellow light keepers. Traverse the island's rugged terrain, discover clues, and make your way through the eerie lighthouse to reveal the dark truth. Demo length ~ 10 min.

title: BoomScroll Demo
description: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

title: Beyond the Broken Veil Demo
description: Beyond the Broken Veil is a heavily inspired RPG of the 90's. As a retired war veteran, uncover the mysteries that plague a war torn continent. Decide rather to embrace the darkness, or become the benevolent protector.

title: Notoris 2: Warlords Demo
description: This is an early demo for  Notoris 2 : Warlords. A 2.5D single-player grand strategy inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms, where legendary generals forge rivalries and alliances in an open-ended sandbox shaped by your tactical choices and turn-based battles.

title: Wēlandes Demo
description: Solve ancient mysteries in the ethereal world of Anglo-Saxon Britain. You are the spel-wefa, use your magical translation devices to help the gods, beasts, and gentlefolk of Old English poetry. Journey the ageless chalk hills surrounding Wayland’s Smithy; unearth the stories that wander within.

title: Bad House Demo
description: Welcome to your new home. Enjoy this free short-term rental, but there's one condition: don’t go into the basement. Discover the first floors of the dungeon-crawling auto-battler in Bad House’s Demo!

title: The Charity Shop Demo
description: The Charity Shop is an atmospheric, surreal puzzle game where you use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived. To this end, you have been delivered to The Charity Shop, a place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.

title: Spacejunk Demo
description: You're Mack, a space janitor with a debt that never shrinks. Third-person arcade space shooter: your RodonGun fires four colors, and every chunk of debris demands the right one. Hit it with the wrong one and it shatters, multiplying your work. Clear the routes. Find out who keeps filling them.

title: Hit The Beer Demo
description: Hit The Beer is a lightweight idle collection game that stays in the corner of your desktop. Your anonymous keyboard rhythm brews different beers without recording what you type, attracting customers with unique tastes to come and sample them.

title: 【体験版】メタルセイヴァーズ
description: 体験版では物語の序盤、第９話までプレイできます。製品版で体験版クリア後の続きからプレイする方法は、製品版のRedame.txtをご確認下さい。ストーリー「ここではない、どこかの地球で…」嘘と秘密、それぞれの正義と愛。別世界の地球を舞台に、全9作品のスーパーロボット・スーパーヒーロー達が集い、数多の敵、数多の災厄に立ち向かっていきます。全40話超の大ボリュームで繰り広げられる、怒涛のクロスオーバー・ストーリー！バトルストーリーを読み進めていくと、バトルパートが始まります。複雑なシステムや操作はナシ！　オーソドックスなコマンドバトルシステムです。戦いの中で戦意を高め、必殺技を決めましょう！オマケストーリーの合間のインターミッションでは、充実のオマケ要素があります。

title: Incremental Wars Demo
description: A short incremental game where you battle enemies with a four-person party while collecting loot. Over one hour of gameplay in the demo (more than four hours in the full game), you’ll unlock a variety of new skills, defeat enemies, and explore different locations in this RPG-style idle game.

title: Path of the Retired Adventurer Demo
description: A semi-idle crafting sim inspired by Path of Exile, for when you still love the loot but not the grind. Forge gear, gamble on affix rolls, and equip the adventurers who quest and delve in your place. Craft their gear, seal their fate.

title: Clean 'Em Ocean Demo
description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

title: Ruin Upon Ruin Demo
description: Roguelike deck-builder where equipment decide your card pool and attack range is here! Make your own loadout from various equipment and conquer the arena.

title: Trucktris Demo
description: Take Trucktris for a test drive with this high horsepower demo version Try your hand at the wheel with 3 hand curated levels from the main game. Master puzzling driving, for free!

title: Vaulted Demo
description: Rumors of the Vault beneath an old fort draw those who have nothing left to lose in a war-torn world. Vaulted is a dieselpunk roguelite shooter. Sneak through the shadows, turn enemies against each other, or fight your way through shifting dungeons to reach the Vault and discover what lies within.

title: The Internal Demo
description: A time-based action roguelike where you battle twisted simulations of your co-workers and climb the corporate ladder before the clock hits 1700.

title: Suits of Fantasia Demo
description: EN: A trail card-battle RPG. Chain cards and build poker hands to challenge the Seven Deadly Kings. This demo is playable up to just before the Gluttony King (Chapter 2).

title: Elta: Defy All Gods - Demo
description: Master a blend of free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration in the Elta: Defy All Gods demo. Experience the beginning of the adrenaline-fueled action-platformer and become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

title: Last Good Festival Demo
description: A psychological horror visual novel with rhythm-based mini-games. Play as a student at a special school, organize its final festival, build relationships with three classmates, and make choices leading to multiple endings—all while uncovering what lies behind the students’ conditions.

title: Checkate Demo
description: Checkate is the roguelike deckbuilder about checkers. Spend gold on rule-bending upgrades, and absurd pieces. Build your deck, chain outrageous combos, crown unstoppable kings and battle iconic bosses. Will you break the balance before it breaks you?

title: Barbe-Yeux Demo
description: Demo of chapter 1 from a comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore an island, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is "Gloubi".

title: Robin Demo
description: A tile-placement roguelike where number go up. No meta progression, no hand-holding. Just cards, hidden rules, and a lot of dopamine once you figure them out.

title: Spellworks Demo
description: Spellworks is a single-player dark fantasy tower defense game where tactical real-time decisions shape every battle. Build and upgrade powerful elemental towers, defend the realms from relentless enemy waves, and defeat epic bosses.

title: Beach Slap Demo
description: There’s only one beach and you are a disgruntled, selfish penguin. Dash, stomp and slap your way to vacation victory in this colorful and chaotic multiplayer brawler.

title: Catch Meow If You Can Demo
description: An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players. Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

title: Five-Star Courier and the Fog That Reeks of Death
Whispers of Orange Island Demo
description: Play as a little girl's soul in this atmospheric 2D stealth puzzle game set in a dark dystopia. Wield magical ancestral tools to rescue wandering spirits, uncover a century of tragic family history, and heal your living families.

title: RaceLineCalc Demo
description: 试用赛车走线计算工具，分析速度、制动与圈速。

title: Southern Lights Demo
description: Begin your journey into the mysteries of Southern Lights, where a routine Antarctic mission soon gives way to an existential fear of the unknown.

title: OshiYa Demo
description: Take your first shifts as a platform attendant in Hakomori. Push passengers aboard, keep crowded trains moving and experience five departures before the first promotion. Your demo save can carry into the full version of OshiYa.

title: Catacrypt Demo
description: Catacrypt is an online co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Enter procedurally generated dungeons to obtain powerful upgrades and craft unique weapons. Descend floors and fight increasingly harder enemies and bosses, all to reach the bottom.

title: Burnout Bistro Demo
description: Run a restaurant, manage your stock, staff, recipe selection and more. Decide how much you want to sacrifice for your career, as not taking care of your personal needs will leave you completely burnt out. How long can you keep everything together?

title: ENDPUNK Demo
description: Discover the world of endpunk from an isometric perspective. Play solo or with friends, chat with others, and jump into action with keyboard or gamepad.

title: Dead Awake Demo
description: You fell asleep in class. You woke up in The Purgatory. Explore a nightmarish world between life and death, manage limited resources, and fight dreadful creatures in a desperate attempt to make it home safe.

title: TROUBLE SHOOTERS Demo
description: The first two sectors of TROUBLE SHOOTERS. Take Grunt through an alien incursion, stack gear until it stops making sense, and put down two bosses. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

title: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental Demo
description: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. An incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

title: Westward Dash Demo
description: The official demo for Westward Dash! Play as Sun Wukong in a brisk 1v1 ink-wash race against the CPU. Play the Classic and One-shot modes, conquer three classic Demon King gates, and sprint to Thunderclap Summit in 10-15 minutes. Wishlist the full game!

title: Hello the undead are coming Demo
The Subminer Demo
description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

title: Inkblood Demo
description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

title: Farhaven Demo
description: PLAY THE DEMO: Build a shared magical town with the people who matter most. A cozy co-op sandbox RPG for up to 16 players, where every crop planted, secret found, and friendship made benefits your whole group.

title: Card Builder Demo
description: Try Card Builder, a card maker for tabletop RPGs, trading card games and board games. Use 31 templates and the full editor to create decks of up to 5 cards, import up to 5 CSV rows, and export watermarked PNGs.

title: Arena Shooter Demo
description: Hop in a tank. Call in a nuke. Flatten the fortress. Battle your friends and bots in a top-down arena shooter with 20 unique maps and modes, 60+ vehicle types, 40+ perks, zombie hordes and a classic Zombie Boss, in a fully destructible world where everything goes.

title: The Halloway Haunting Demo
description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore five abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

title: InkQuest: Text Game Engine Demo
description: InkQuest is a simple way to make your own text adventure — the kind of game you play by reading and typing. Draw rooms on a map, fill them with things, set the rules from menus. No coding. When it's finished, share your game with anyone.

title: FTS: Frontline Tank Survivor Demo
description: A Survivors-like roguelite — with a tank. Play the complete first stage of FTS for free, fight through hundreds of enemies, upgrade the tank between waves, and build overwhelming firepower with powerful skills and battlefield support.

title: Ball Pit Cleanup Demo
description: Sort thousands of colorful balls into matching pipes. Unlock upgrades and work more efficiently, but be careful: every mistake adds more balls to the pile.

title: BrinkBreakers Demo
description: Build your deck, collect powerful artifacts, and forge game-breaking synergies as you battle through a corrupted galaxy. Choose your path, adapt your strategy, and push deeper into the Void in this roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Organ Failure Demo
description: A turn-based surgery in medieval times, against a silly Plague Doctor. Find the Sick Organ, kill less patients and extract their Hearts for an upper hand.

title: Overcommit: Probation Demo
description: Overcommit: Probation is a narrative card-driven corporate satire about your first days as a junior programmer. Survive onboarding, strange legacy code, office rituals, and the quiet horror of proving your worth before the probation period ends.

title: Heartbeats - Anniversary Edition Demo
description: A stylish point-and-click puzzle game where cryptic logic puzzles unlock the next chapter of a man's story. Try the first 3 levels in this demo!

title: Trickstir Demo
description: Solve puzzles by rotating the environment to drop ingredients in your cauldron. In this Demo, play through 15+ stages, discovering blocks and ingredients with special twists. Collect the ingredients to help the witch create the ultimate potion!

title: Oldest Golden Treasure Demo
description: Play the first chapter of the game for free in this Demo! Step into the role of a detective, solve puzzles, and uncover the first clues behind your colleague's disappearance. Travel through time and explore immersive worlds in this VR escape room adventure, then continue the story in the full game.

title: Necrolord Demo
description: Command an undead army as a Lich in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite demo. Raise the fallen, equip your troops, and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands and play until you defeat the first Inquisition.

title: Crown Bluff Demo
description: Crown Bluff is a game of betrayal for 2 to 12 players. Everyone hides a secret role. A loyal knight, a hidden rebel, or a traitor smiling at your side. Find who shares your goal, and take down everyone who doesn't.

title: The Regreening Demo
description: The Regreening is a cozy simulation game about restoring nature in a soilpunk fairytale. Grow plants to create living ecosystems, become friends with ancient spirits, make your own upcycling hub, and hug ALL the animals! Can you transform this deserted world into a joyful home again?

title: Mercyrail: Haven Bound Demo
description: You're driving the last crewed train out of a dead London. This free demo covers the opening of the campaign, Waterloo and the routes into the Home Counties, on the real UK rail network. The rest of the run north to Haven is in the full game.

title: Purgatory Pitstop Demo
description: Your diner is the final stop before the infamous afterlife gate. Let customers drown their sorrows for profit, or attempt to show them a better way? You decide in this fully-voiced, morally confronting choice-based game.

title: Survival Fund Manager Demo
description: Play a turn-based strategy board game against three AI fund managers. Reveal information or keep it under embargo to shape stock prices, take long or short positions, and time your exit. Beat the Bank threshold and claim the highest return.

title: Please Buy My Junk! Demo
description: An Item Shop Tycoon Game!! Hunt critters, collect their junk and sell it off to some very cool customers that come into your little shop! Become rich and powerful and cool in this unique fantasy world!!

title: Numpad Chef: Pizza Rush Demo
description: Turn your numpad into a pizza kitchen. Type fast, cook faster. Master a unique number-based control system as you prepare, top, and bake pizzas under pressure in a cozy 3D farm kitchen, where every order counts and every mistake matters.

title: Oaks vs Orcs Demo
description: Build a forest kingdom, bend the river through your strongest tiles, and stack broken combinations in this roguelike strategy autobattler. Adapt to the seasons, then watch your army crush waves of lumber-hungry orcs.

title: Anti-anti Demo
description: The demo includes content from Parts 1 and 2 and has a 30-minute time limit.The timer does not run while you are in the main menu or the game is paused.

title: OKUREK Demo
description: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

title: Power Grid Tycoon
description: Get a first look at Power Grid Tycoon, a 3D power-grid construction and management game. Explore its building tools and basic controls in this demo, and discover whether hands-on grid building is for you.

title: Paw Pop Breakout Demo
description: Paw Pop Breakout is a fast-paced brick-breaking deckbuilding roguelike. Smash bricks and collect shards before time runs out. Your deck determines which bricks, power-ups, and obstacles appear. Build unique synergies, face random challenges, and break through the ever-increasing difficulty!

title: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo
description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

title: Tearoom of Terror Demo
description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 13 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try not to end up on the menu before Halloween. The free demo serves seven delightful ways to die, dog included.

title: Jet Birds Demo
description: Jet Birds is a physics-based 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended across breathtaking natural environments. Race against the clock, master challenging courses, and climb the global leaderboards.

title: Planet Gray Starlight Episode Demo
description: An adventure game where you travel through the galaxy together in a spaceship.

title: Massive Collapse Demo
description: Massive Collapse is a round-based multiplayer shooter where every match begins with a new build. Choose your race, combine spells and gadgets to create new strategies built to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm your opponents.

title: Homesider Survivors Demo
description: HOMESIDER SURVIVORS is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. You find yourself far from home against countless hordes of aliens...but they're the ones who have to survive, because they kidnapped the wrong guy. Kill, die, level up, and try again until you get home.

title: Can-do Streamer Hiyori-chan (No lewd comments please!) Demo
Within His View Demo
description: Free demo: one full night shift in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 0:00 to 7:00. Seven analog camera feeds, 175 hand-crafted anomalies to spot and report, and a Wendigo that hunts you in complete silence. The full game releases on October 28, 2026.

title: Intend System Demo
description: Struggling with inconsistent aim days? Stop relying on luck and start relying on your biology. With the Intend System, you will enter flow-state instantly. This bio-mechanical tool aligns your visual intent with physical precision, offloading control to your subconscious for effortless accuracy.

title: Legend of Defenders Demo
description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

title: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim Demo
description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

title: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War Demo
description: Experience real-time army battles and selected Historical Campaign trial content in this Demo. Choose officers, deploy formations, command sieges and fight duels. Supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean.

title: FLEX KING Demo
description: Read the aim, dodge in four directions, and strike back in bullet time. Take on solo arcade challenges or team up in local two-player co-op, dodging together through changing formations. Practice tough stages, push further in Endless mode, and make every move look good.

title: POMOLOGIA Demo
description: Collect 200 real-world fruits and combine their abilities in this deck-building match-3 puzzle.

title: SUSHI PARADE Demo
description: Open your own sushi bar, right on your desktop. Not in a window — the sushi drifts across your working screen, and only the sushi catches your clicks, so your work is never in the way. From everyday maguro akami to ankimo, collect 100+ kinds and fill out the sushi dex!

title: Guns That Go Ribbit! Demo
description: A comedy microgame collection from the frog war. Dozens of five-second missions: catch the fly, pump the shotgun, don't shoot. One command, one input, no time to think. The speed never stops climbing. A full campaign, boss fights, and an endless tour of duty.

title: De Potrero Demo
description: This is De Potrero playable demonstration. It will let you access the most basic features of the game, check the gameplay loop in a span of 3 in game years with a young footballer.

title: Ripple Lane 101 : Moments With You Demo
description: Share quiet campus dorm life with Yiling in an idle companion game. Focus with a Pomodoro timer, track plans and ideas, relax to Lofi and white noise, and choose outfits and decor. Explore her future world through stories fully voiced in Chinese, and uncover secrets about yourself.

title: The Collective Demo
description: The Collective is a horror comedy RPG set in an strange world. You are alone, confused, imprisoned, and your choices matter more than you think. This game fuses elements of Fear & Hunger, Resident Evil, and Disco Elysium together in a fascinating concoction of a J-RPG.

title: ZERO KNOWLEDGE Demo
description: The system says you did it. Prove otherwise. Build a deck of mythic Archetypes and hacker Protocols, capture a 4×4 board, and follow the evidence through the Darknet bazaar. This free demo includes two starting approaches and one Enclave.

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Demo
description: Experience the beginning of Castlevania: Belmont's Curse in this demo! ・ Save data from the demo can be transferred to the full game. ・ Some content featured in the demo may differ from the full game.

title: Mining Mike Demo
description: Mikey Minerals owes the Shimigu Mining Corporation TRILLIONS in college debt. His sentence: the remote planet Dirt. Strap into a mech-themed roguelike mining tower defense survivor. Battle hordes, build a base, MINE and make money for the COMPANY.
developer: Heavy Photon, web-gnar, Banana Slip Games

title: Stake Demo
description: Stake is a deep, text-and-grid gothic survival simulation. Navigate a procedurally generated world where vampires rule the night and scavengers rule the day. Manage your health, sanity, and humanity. Scavenge for supplies, fortify safehouses, haul heavy loot, and methodically eradicate the undead.

title: Lode Builder Demo
description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

title: 全面抗战  War in Asia Demo
HASSO Demo
description: A single-player samurai card game about linking blades. Each technique only chains with the one it fits, like dominoes, and the longer the chain the harder it lands. Your opponent's blades decide how much of it survives. Two schools, hidden paths, one campaign of duels.

title: Timberline Factory Demo
description: A physics based sawmill simulation - tycoon where logs aren't just rigid icons, but physical objects that roll, collide, and jam. Automate complex production lines, master a dynamic market index, and turn waste into green energy.

title: Iron Frame Demo
description: The first three bosses of a bullet-heaven roguelite fought in a single ship. Nine frames, ten guns across forty tiers, and a hull that visibly grows with every level. Everything you unlock here carries into the full game.

title: Pinball Chemist Demo
description: Interns welcome! AChemicalNet is hiring and you are being given the chance at promotion of a lifetime! Find new elements and use them to create powerful solutions!

title: BOZÓ! Demo
description: BOZÓ is a dice roguelite where every roll can change your run. Build powerful combinations, use unique cards and relics, face dangerous challenges, and discover how far your luck can take you.

title: Balls to the Walls Demo
description: A short incremental physics game about upgrading and annihilating your balls. Equip chaotic special balls and buy physics-altering upgrades to break the simulation and get rich.

title: Midnight Rogues Demo
description: Build the sequence that fights for you in this roguelike auto-battler. Buy items and arrange them across your board, then watch a timer activate them in order. Change their placement to create powerful combinations and take down The City’s corrupted superheroes.

title: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy Demo
description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a small action-adventure game. You are an adventurer in training about to take your final exam. This demo includes 2 dungeons.

title: Stellacore Defense Demo
description: A 2D pixel art tower defense game with unparalleled strategic depth. Deploy modules to redirect enemies, use tactical chips to command the battlefield, and upgrade towers with multi-branch modifications to protect humanity's vital Stellacore energy.

title: AstroVoids Demo
description: Blast through space enemies, master insane upgrades, and face cosmic horrors! AstroVoids is a frantic action roguelike where every choice shapes your build. Upgrade your ship, survive waves of chaos, and fight for the top of the leaderboard!

title: Pixel Pirates Demo
description: Set sail as James Flint to rescue your partner Clara from the cursed Captain Blackwood. Battle ruthless pirates, uncover secrets on handcrafted islands, hunt for treasure, and discover powerful relics in this byte-sized high-seas adventure.

title: Colosseum Infection Demo
description: "Build your unique strategy stress-free, with zero time pressure! Combine synergies, augments, and items to form an unstoppable army. Step into immersive unit-view combat, taking direct control with manual movement and tactical potion throws to reverse the odds in this strategic auto-battler."

title: Endless Void: Idle Tower Defence Demo
description: Shoot. Upgrade. Die. Repeat. Defend against endless swarms in this minimalist idle tower defense. Construct an impenetrable fortress, research game-breaking tech, craft legendary gear, and harness cosmic abilities like Black Holes and Orbital Strikes. How deep into the Void can you survive?

title: Liminal Depths Demo
description: A pixel liminal horror game about surviving an endless maze, recovering who you are, and escaping before the Depths take you. Explore procedural halls, complete jobs from the safehouse computer, upgrade your gear, and face monsters that hunt by sound, sight, and movement, solo or local split-screen.

title: Dungeon Buster Demo
description: Build the dungeon. Send in your hero. Extract the loot. Grow stronger. Dungeon Buster is an incremental dungeon-building autobattler RPG built around permanent progression and deeper expeditions.

title: 万象大厦 Demo
description: This is a pixel adventure puzzle game. "You" are lost in a strange shopping mall, and the only way to leave is to complete your shopping list. Distorted memories, a past filled with regrets. If you could go back to "that night," if you could return to the Phantom Mall...

title: Fleets of Valor Demo
description: Fleets of Valor is a single-player WWII naval real-time tactics game. In this free demo, command cruisers and destroyers during the training mission to sink enemy ships. Then defend Pearl Harbor with the 40mm Bofors gun, escort bombers and engage in dogfights.

title: Outbreak: Type Z Demo
description: Your keyboard is the weapon: type a zombie's word and it goes down. Or switch to RUN & GUN and play it as a shooter instead. A story campaign, arena mode, and an endless roguelite, in a city that rebuilds itself every run.

title: Celebria Demo
description: From movie star to music icon, you run the show in Celebria. Guide your entertainer through landing roles, releasing music, touring the world, climbing global charts, chasing prestigious awards, and running a celebrity brand, all while navigating the pressures of fame.

title: Green Space Demo
description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

title: Abyss Card Legends Demo
description: Clear stages for god-tier gear, sacrifice to summon the Boss! In Abyss Card Legends, resurrect the ultimate Demon King with your own hands and claim the most game-breaking loot!

title: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike Demo
description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

title: KOE – Beyond Demo
description: Play the complete first playthrough of KOE — Beyond, from beginning to end.

title: Pop 'Un Orc Demo
description: Choose your hero and recruit your army, battle your way through hordes of Orcs and Dwarves as you pop your way to victory.

title: Still Trails: Camping Demo
description: In this demo, you can take a look at Still Trails: Camping's core mechanics and a portion of its best map. Set up your tent, chair, and campfire after a long hike! Enjoy a walking simulator with beautiful sights and relaxing sounds.

title: MaskloZoophic Sessions Demo
description: Entering an abandoned comic studio, equipped with a flashlight, spirit box and notepad. Your job is to find out about the spirits of the past without getting caught by the haunted costumes.

title: Tower of Fangs: Summoned to Another World, I Was Locked in a Tower with 299 Strikers, Only the Last Egoist Goes Home Demo
Life of Pawn: Chocolate and Marshmallow Demo
description: We are candy chess pieces in a world made of sweets. Jump, solve, evolve — and learn real chess together.

title: DUSTBLOOM Demo
description: DUSTBLOOM demo: play the first three nights of a co-op survival game on a dead red planet. Mine, build your base, survive the first skeleton siege and start terraforming. Single-player only — online co-op arrives with Early Access. Demo saves don't carry over.

title: 拉斯普特的龙与魔女 Demo
description: -背景&故事 The Story「拉斯普特的龙与魔女」是一部有情节错综复杂的视觉小说作品。在这个魔法生物存在且被人所知的世界，机械学勃勃发展、蒸汽滚滚而来，人类正式进入自己亲手缔造而成的黄金时代。主人公弗莱· 威廉姆斯身负光复家族的使命，就读于拉普斯特旁的大学园。直到新的学年伊始，以委托猎手身份做兼职活动的他，接到一个神秘棘手的客单，由此揭开戏剧性帷幕。-角色介绍 CHARACTERS-游戏特点 GAME FEATURES※风格化立绘和十余张CG、辅以准影视级演出，打造沉浸体验※约30首原创BGM，部分场景运用空间音效技术，推荐使用耳机游玩※二十余张游戏背景让不同主题区域活灵活现※推荐玩法：第一步：戴上耳机，准备好饮料零食。第二步：打开本游戏。第三步：尽情享受。

title: Reap & Repeat Demo
description: Reap & Repeat is a satisfying active incremental game about harvesting an ever-growing ecosystem. Cut plants, earn upgrades, improve your scythe, and make vegetation grow faster, denser, and more valuable as your tiny harvest turns into field-clearing chaos.

title: Tidy Slot Cars Demo
description: Tidy a slot car club and take your favourites to the track! Unlock cars as you tidy, build your own circuits, and race your cat or a friend in local split-screen.

title: Honey or Else Demo
description: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

title: Tidy Arcana Demo
description: This is the demo of Tidy Arcana, a cozy first person organizing game about restoring a magical library.

title: Casa de Cuy: A Finca Full of Fluff Demo
MataOno Demo
description: You've never rolled big ones quite like this. MataOno is a chaotic dice roguelike deckbuilder about assembling dice and building combos that massively cascade out of control. Pair item effects to stack your multipliers and turn single-digit rolls into numbers that can't even fit on your screen.

title: THE GRAVES VIGIL Demo
description: The Graves Vigil is an atmospheric psychological horror game with point-and-click elements. Alone in the Graves estate, you must survive until five in the morning: spot anomalies, guard your sanity, and keep the house from sinking into darkness.

title: 看黑鸟的十三种方式 Demo
description: 一款以自我定义，记忆与选择为核心的多结局视觉小说。游戏以主角瑞克洛温（Racloven）的第一视角展开，在探索世界的同时，从他人彼此矛盾的叙述中剥离出过去的“自己”。旅途中与形形色色的角色相遇，建立关系，获得线索，并在一次次选择中走向不同的结局——当每个人记忆中的你都不尽相同，你又会选择成为谁？

title: Parcel Panic Demo
description: A VR arcade frenzy at the world's worst delivery hub. Sort fast, keep your combo alive, don't flip the fragile ones, and never leave your post. Just one more shift…

title: Medieval Squad Tactics Demo
description: This game is focused on turn based tactical combats. The complexity of the game comes from having to carefully manage your various formations in order to defeat your enemies. Carefully plan your actions to win the battle.

title: Fairwell Demo
description: You've inherited your father's old golf club, long since neglected. Armed with a worn-out mower, a little cash, and a grounds crew who came with the place, you set out to bring it back. Can you restore Fairwell to what it once was?

title: Stellar Courier Demo
description: Arcade space shooter. You are a courier with one package to deliver across a broken galaxy. Plane-like flight, fights with pirates, the old army and aliens in a 20+ mission story campaign. Pick your ship and mods between missions. No grind, no filler.

title: Kill Breach Demo
description: KILL BREACH is a brutal, fast-paced roguelite FPS where relentless horde shooting meets infinite weapon upgrades. Break into a randomly generated facility where no two runs are the same. Turn yourself into a machine of mass destruction, and RIP apart anything that moves.

title: Smile Run Demo
description: An endless runner with adorable characters. Run through multiple environments with different play styles. Play two modes of either limited time Gift Delivery or endless Ice Cream mode. Multiple levels of increasing difficulty.

title: SnorQ Demo
description: SnorQ is a dark fantasy pixel art action roguelite. Explore levels generated in ever changing sequences. Collect crystals, unlock abilities, choose bonuses. In the full game, you will face SnorQ, the distorted version of yourself that wants to keep you in oblivion. Local coop for up to 2 players.

title: Luminara: The Second Dawn Demo
description: Medieval fantasy daughter-raising sim with adventure and romance elements. You are a single father, and every step of your daughter's journey is yours to guide. Study, adventure, make friends, fall in love… 70+ endings, each playthrough a new story. Ready to raise the most wonderful daughter of all?

title: Temporal Minesweeper Demo
description: Reason across time: a cell that is safe now may be a mine the next moment. With only the clues and rules, solve the puzzle step by step — without ever guessing. Combined rules build on one another for a pure brain-teaser.

title: 灵劫变 Demo
description: 《灵劫变》是一款开放世界玄幻修仙角色扮演游戏。你可以使用自己的专属形象在数万格的手工地图中不断探索全新机缘，体验蝴蝶效应般的非线性剧情与红尘情缘。除却驾驭灵兽与法宝进行策略战斗，你还能开辟洞府、经营宗门，甚至与道侣建立家族，亲自培养下一代天骄，开启有温度的修真之路。

title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator Demo
description: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

title: Subterfuge Demo
description: A week-long multiplayer game of strategy, diplomacy, and betrayal. Schedule moves for hours in the future, forge fragile alliances, and time the perfect backstab as events unfold in real time. Coming to Steam Early Access with mobile cross-play and a player pool running since 2015.

title: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet Demo
description: Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite. Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them. Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score. Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

title: CASHGRAB Demo
description: CASHGRAB is an arcade time-attack 2D platformer. Play as Joey, a duck who sold the rights to a movie adaptation of his last adventure. He has to run, jump, stomp and dash to defeat enemies and grab the cash as fast as he can because the producers want to complete the movie as fast as possible!

title: Halloween Poppp Demo
description: Demo Content: • Full access to Easy Mode • Combo system & Gem upgrade system unlocked • All items available to use • Built-in leaderboard (data not shared with full game) • Local achievements (not synced with full release)Note: The Easy Mode in demo is great for new players.

title: Cozy Plates Demo
description: Decorate your own elegant plates using a variety of delicious ingredients, from sushi to sweet desserts. Arrange every detail with easy controls, set the cozy atmosphere, and create the perfect presentation. Relax, learn at your own pace, and get into the flow.

title: Adventurer 95 Demo
description: Попробуйте Roguelite-RPG на ретро-рабочем столе. Играйте за Воина, выбирайте навыки, находите добычу и сражайтесь с боссами. Мастерство ограничено 3-м уровнем, а количество походов не ограничено.

title: A BILLION GOLD DEBT Demo
description: Grow your settlement, automate production, explore the surrounding lands, and trade with your neighbors to repay a debt of 1 BILLION gold!

title: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready Demo
description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

title: Split Happens Demo
description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 6 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

title: Florana Defense Demo
description: Incremental Mazing Tower Defense game where you do not loose anything, just earn more and more gold to buy upgrades to earn  more gold.This game is about earning gold to create the best tower defense maze that can mow through most and best mobs you can buy for gold.

title: DOG LIVES: Space Pirates War Alpha version Demo
description: (Limited Demo Coming Soon) The year is 2083. Humanity’s long-standing struggle with space pirates is reaching its climax. As a "lapdog of the military," pilot your mass-produced Metal Frame (MF), crush rival pirate factions, recruit them to your side, and conquer the Pirate War!

title: 真夜之刃 Demo
description: After a fall from his school building erases nearly a year of his memories, high school student Chenxing is caught between two conflicting versions of his romantic past. Follow missing clues, face supernatural attacks, and decide whose truth to confront first in this all-ages visual novel Demo.

title: Tiny Harbor Demo
description: Tiny Harbor is a cozy desktop fishing management game where you grow your fleet, discover new species, expand production and automate your harbor, all while your little world keeps running alongside whatever else you’re doing.

title: Paper Tower: Idle Overlay Demo
description: A desktop companion idle auto-battler in isometric 3D that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things. Collect your loot, upgrade your tower and defeat endless waves of enemies.

title: 9.8 Demo
description: A 2D space agency simulator where every object follows the same orbital physics. Land on moons, build colonies, deploy satellites, and reshape entire planetary systems. Deorbit a moon if you want.

title: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist Demo
description: Welcome to the demo of Potion Making Practice - the digital version of the cult classic board game! Brew elixirs, earn movement tokens, and reach three Places of Power to reignite the Flame of Life.

title: Facelet Demo
description: Facelet is a roguelike deckbuilder played on a scrambled puzzle cube. Twist layers to line up colors, cash them in, and build a deck that scores a cube nobody would ever finish. Spend your winnings on Algorithms, Mods, stickers and Tools, then take the bigger cube into the next Depth.

title: The Drowned Table Demo
description: After a shipwreck, wake at a table that keeps score. Build a bag of strange dice in this free horror roguelike demo, combine Common dice and Curios, choose a route across the Sea Chart, and face eight depths. No time limit; save your voyage and return later.

title: Vital Decisions Demo
description: Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

title: Desktop Rave Demo
description: Desktop Rave is an audio-reactive desktop companion and idle management game. Use your own music to drive the in-game economy and create your own unique club.

title: Roll with Splonk Demo
description: Splonk lives in the corner of your screen, on top of everything else, happily rolling dice and printing money while you watch stuff, browse, or pretend to work. Roll, get rich, buy better stuff, repeat.

title: Meteors Are Art Demo
description: These days, destroying planets has become one of the hottest forms of art in the universe. The process is simple. Choose a meteor, attach some parts, and fire it at a planet. You can even choose your own judges. Would you like to join this world of art?

title: Knightime Demo
description: Time is ticking! Survive medieval hordes in this low-poly action rogue-lite bullet heaven. Unlock an army of 27 unique knights bound to their elemental weaponry, master geometric spirals, and break the game before the 15-minute clock runs out. Can you claim a seat at the Hexagonal Table?

title: Agile Team Demo
description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner. Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

title: Yeet Animals Gently Demo
description: Flick a ball at a pen full of very cute animals. Each hit drains a stamina bar, and an empty bar sends one sailing over the fence to land on its feet. Every landing pays. Spend it on a skill tree, unlock new species, and move to a new arena.

title: Basketball Dynasty Demo
description: Build your ultimate team in Basketball Dynasty, a tactical 2D basketball management sim. Make real-time coaching decisions, call plays, and scout top talents. Combine deep strategy with RPG gear progression to lead your squad to glory!

title: Dread of the Deep Demo
description: Aim your beam, fire, and choose which side to leave in the dark. Fight overwhelming hordes and combine weapons into powerful builds. Shape your lighthouse with a sprawling talent tree, and uncover what waits beneath the waves.

title: The Final Days of Olin Earl Demo
description: In this short and sweet demo version, Olin Earl has just entered Lawson Manor, where he believes his grandson Alan Earl could be held captive. Explore the manor in the flesh and as a ghost, evading security while touring an impressive art collection.

title: FreshSheets Demo
description: Clean hotel rooms, satisfy guests, earn money, and work your way up to owning and managing your dream hotel.

title: Eldritch Break Demo
description: Vibrant, high-octane 2.5D Boomer Shooter that smashes together the fast-paced action of classics like Doom and Duke Nukem with the mind-bending, non-Euclidean environments of an eldritch prison.

title: Infinite Dice Demo
description: Infinite Dice is a short, incremental game about rolling and upgrading your dice for money and dots, while you do quests and interesting challenges. Discover the multiple types of dice (D6, D8, demon, combo, etc.) and beat the dice bosses!

title: Night Drive - Anomaly Demo
description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

title: Rogue Reels Demo
description: Gamble your way up in this slot machine roguelite! Upgrade and manipulate the machines in your favor. Enhance your reels, win big and break the bank while defying ever-increasing odds.

title: Last Man Running Demo
description: Try Last Man Running with up to 4 players in local or online multiplayer. This demo includes one procedurally generated level, all game modes, and a selection of character skins. Bring your friends and give it a run!

title: BPM Boy Demo
description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, featuring hidden secrets, leaderboards for speed-runners and a funky original soundtrack. The BPM Boy demo is a small sampling of the levels, hazards, music and fun to be had in the full game.

title: CubeMate Demo
description: CubeMate is a chess-inspired 3D puzzle game. Rotate the cube, outthink the board, and solve hand-crafted puzzles — one move at a time.

title: Ludus Saltuum Demo
description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

title: Ashen Legacy Demo
description: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

title: Strive Card Demo
description: Strive Card is a deckbuilding roguelike won with Niu Niu poker hands. Build a five-card Niu Niu, line your Strive Cards up so additive bonuses feed the multipliers, reshape your deck with Tech Cards, and clear 24 solar terms and 8 stage bosses to push one hand into the billions.

title: StellarSips:A Bartender’s Tale Demo
description: Stellar Sips: A Bartender's Tale is a relaxing visual novel. As a bartender on a turbulent colony, mix drinks and cook meals to spark unique conversations with diverse guests from across the galaxy. Unlock different endings and quietly shape the world's fate.

title: KRIS: The Last Good Summer Demo
FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves - Demo Version -
description: This is the demo version of FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves.

title: Brofish Demo
description: Brofish is an autobattler roguelite with Tower Defense elements. Catch and upgrade bizarre fish, combine items, effects, and hold back waves of undead to save the village from the Sea King!

title: Corrupt Receptionist Elina Demo
